    _need(isinstance(old_hooks, dict), "old native hooks invalid")
    hook_root = new_state.parent.parent / "native-hooks"
    hooks: dict[str, Any] = {"bounded_no_new_relay": True}
    for phase in ("prerun", "postrun"):
        old_hook = old_hooks.get(phase)
        path = hook_root / ("handoff-" + phase + ".sh")
        _need(
            isinstance(old_hook, dict) and _sha(host._read(path)[1]) == old_hook.get("sha256"),
            "new hook differs from old reviewed hook",
        )
        hooks[phase] = {"path": str(path), "sha256": old_hook["sha256"]}
    module_dir = _canonical(new["module_dir"])
    lease = module_dir / "closer_native_lease.py"
    _need(
        _sha(host._read(lease)[1]) == new["modules"].get(lease.name), "new lease module pin differs"
    )
    hooks["lease_module"] = {"path": str(lease), "sha256": new["modules"][lease.name]}
    interpreter = new["mechanism_contract"]["interpreter"]
    _need(isinstance(interpreter, dict), "new interpreter physical pin missing")
    mirror = (Path.home() / ".codex/orchestrator-mirror/closer_dispatcher.py").resolve()
    _need(
        _sha(host._read(mirror)[1]) == new["modules"].get(mirror.name),
        "current dispatcher pin differs",
    )
    hooks["postrun_dependencies"] = {
        "interpreter": {"path": interpreter["path"], "sha256": interpreter["sha256"]},
        "dispatcher": {"path": str(mirror), "sha256": new["modules"][mirror.name]},
    }
    cfg["native_hooks"] = hooks
    return cfg


def _old_custody_quiet(old: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Physical custody is evidence, not a JSON claim from a caller."""
    import closer_correction_controller as controller

    controller_file = Path(controller.__file__).resolve()
    _need(
        old.get("modules", {}).get(controller_file.name) == _sha(host._read(controller_file)[1]),
        "current controller differs from old pinned controller",
    )
    config = old["policy"]["correction_controller_installation"]["config"]
    try:
        inspection = controller.inspect_provisioned_custody(config)
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, RuntimeError) as exc:
        raise SourceUpgradeHeld("old physical custody unavailable") from exc
    _need(
        not inspection["highwater"]["pending_transactions"], "old custody has pending transaction"
    )
    custody_path = _canonical(inspection["identity"]["custody_path"])
    _need(
        set(os.listdir(custody_path))
        == {"namespace.json", "highwater-0000000000000000.json", "writer.lock"},
        "old custody inventory is not pristine no-ACT state",
    )
    _need(
        inspection["highwater"]["anchor"].get("revision") == 0, "old custody revision is not zero"
    )
    _need(
        controller.inspect_provisioned_custody(config) == inspection,
        "old custody changed during recheck",
    )
    return inspection


def fresh_read_native_index(config: dict[str, Any], inspection: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Bounded GET-only proof that remote native index still is the old anchor."""
    import closer_correction_controller as controller

    anchor = inspection["highwater"]["anchor"]
    repository = config.get("repository")
    if not isinstance(repository, str) or not repository:
        raise SourceUpgradeHeld("controller repository unavailable")

    def get(endpoint: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            call = subprocess.run(
                ["gh", "api", endpoint], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10, check=False
            )
            _need(
                call.returncode == 0 and len(call.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024,
                "native index GET unavailable",
            )
            value = json.loads(call.stdout)
        except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
            raise SourceUpgradeHeld("native index GET unavailable") from exc
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise SourceUpgradeHeld("native index GET response invalid")
        return value

    ref = get("repos/" + repository + "/git/ref/heads/" + controller.BRANCH)
    _need(ref.get("object", {}).get("sha") == anchor["commit_sha"], "native index head changed")
    contents = get(
        "repos/"
        + repository
        + "/contents/"
        + controller.INDEX_PATH
        + "?ref="
        + anchor["commit_sha"]
    )
    _need(
        contents.get("sha") == anchor["blob_sha"] and contents.get("encoding") == "base64",
        "native index blob changed",
    )
    principal, repo = get("user"), get("repos/" + repository)
    _need(
        {key: principal.get(key) for key in ("id", "login", "type")}
        == {
            "id": config.get("writer_id"),
            "login": config.get("writer_login"),
            "type": config.get("writer_type"),
        },
        "native index principal changed",
    )
    _need(
        repo.get("id") == config.get("repository_id")
        and controller.native_repository_name(repo.get("full_name"), repository.lower()),
        "native index repository changed",
    )
    try:
        raw = base64.b64decode(str(contents.get("content", "")).replace("\n", ""), validate=True)
        data = json.loads(raw)
        _need(
            controller.validate_index(data, controller.ControllerConfig(**config)) == data,
            "native index source validation failed",
        )
    except (ValueError, TypeError, RuntimeError) as exc:
        raise SourceUpgradeHeld("native index payload invalid") from exc
    _need(controller.digest(data) == anchor["state_sha256"], "native index state changed")
    _need(data.get("revision") == 0 and data.get("entries") == [], "native index not pristine")
    return {
        "commit_sha": anchor["commit_sha"],
        "blob_sha": anchor["blob_sha"],
        "state_sha256": anchor["state_sha256"],
        "principal": {key: principal[key] for key in ("id", "login", "type")},
        "repository_id": repo["id"],
        "repository": repo["full_name"],
    }


def _inert_new_custody(
    manifest: dict[str, Any], state: Path, anchor: dict[str, Any]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Inspect only pre-provisioned metadata while the new campaign is absent.

    The controller's full inspector intentionally requires an existing campaign.
    This check grants no controller authority; normal admission uses that full
    inspector after the producer has created and sealed the held campaign.
    """
    import closer_correction_controller as controller

    config = controller.ControllerConfig(
        **manifest["policy"]["correction_controller_installation"]["config"]
    )
    root = host._path(Path(str(state) + ".evidence") / config.namespace)
    before = root.stat()
    _need(
        stat.S_ISDIR(before.st_mode)
        and before.st_uid == os.getuid()
        and stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode) == 0o700,
        "new inert custody is not private/owned",
    )
    expected = {
        "namespace.json": controller.canonical(
            {
                "schema": "local-correction-controller-namespace/v1",
                "config_sha256": controller.digest(config.source_binding()),
            }
        ),
        "highwater-0000000000000000.json": controller.canonical(anchor),
        "writer.lock": b"",
    }
    _need(set(os.listdir(root)) == set(expected), "new inert custody inventory differs")
    files = {}
    for name, raw in expected.items():
        path, observed = host._read(root / name)
        info = path.stat()
        _need(observed == raw and not info.st_mode & 0o077, "new inert custody bytes/mode differ")
        files[name] = {"sha256": _sha(raw), "device": info.st_dev, "inode": info.st_ino}
    after = root.stat()
    _need(
        (before.st_dev, before.st_ino) == (after.st_dev, after.st_ino)
        and set(os.listdir(root)) == set(expected),
        "new inert custody changed during inspection",
    )
    return {
        "identity": {"custody_path": str(root), "device": before.st_dev, "inode": before.st_ino},
        "files": files,
    }


def _wrapper_plan(
    old_manifest: Path, old: dict[str, Any], new_manifest: Path, new: dict[str, Any], receipt: Path
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Delegate rendering/CAS shape to the reviewed installer, before the CAS."""
    import closer_native_wrapper_install as install

    restored, _ = install._restored_predecessor(receipt)
    base = install._guard_source(install._archived_base(restored))
    wrapper = Path.home() / ".codex/bin/cursor-lane.sh"
    before = host._read(wrapper)[1]
    _need(_sha(before) == old["mechanism_contract"]["wrapper"]["sha256"], "old wrapper pin differs")
    _need(before == install._render(base, old, old_manifest), "old wrapper is not canonical render")
    after = install._render(base, new, new_manifest)
    _need(_sha(after) == new["mechanism_contract"]["wrapper"]["sha256"], "new wrapper pin differs")
    return {"path": str(wrapper), "before_sha256": _sha(before), "after_sha256": _sha(after)}


def plan(
    old_manifest: str | Path,
    old_state: str | Path,
    worker_id: str,
    new_manifest: str | Path,
    new_state: str | Path,
    restore_receipt: str | Path,
    new_worker_config: dict[str, Any],
    frontier: dict[str, Any],
    new_release_journal: str | Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Seal no-ACT old evidence and prepare a new source-owned wrapper CAS."""
    import closer_native_wrapper_install as install

    candidate_path, old_raw, candidate_old = _object(old_manifest, "old manifest")
    failed_before_pipeline = (
        candidate_old.get("candidate_sha") == "dd8d71119b92e15ff85836cc44ad40e20207ac6f"
    )
    generic_pre_effect = not failed_before_pipeline and candidate_old.get("candidate_sha") not in {
        REVIEWED_OLD_CANDIDATE,
        REVIEWED_CAPACITY_CANDIDATE,
        REVIEWED_CLOCK_CANDIDATE,
        REVIEWED_OWNERSHIP_BUDGET_CANDIDATE,
        REVIEWED_SEED_ASSESSMENT_CANDIDATE,
        REVIEWED_PAGINATION_CANDIDATE,
    }
    if failed_before_pipeline:
        old_path, old = candidate_path, candidate_old
    elif generic_pre_effect:
        old_path, _validated_old_raw, old = _generic_pre_effect_manifest(old_manifest)
        _need(_validated_old_raw == old_raw, "old manifest changed during validation")
    else:
        old_path, _validated_old_raw, old = _manifest(old_manifest, old=True)
        _need(_validated_old_raw == old_raw, "old manifest changed during validation")
    new_path, new_raw, new = _manifest(new_manifest)
    _need(
        generic_pre_effect
        or old.get("candidate_sha")
        in {
            REVIEWED_OLD_CANDIDATE,
            REVIEWED_CAPACITY_CANDIDATE,
            REVIEWED_CLOCK_CANDIDATE,
            REVIEWED_OWNERSHIP_BUDGET_CANDIDATE,
            REVIEWED_SEED_ASSESSMENT_CANDIDATE,
            REVIEWED_PAGINATION_CANDIDATE,
            "dd8d71119b92e15ff85836cc44ad40e20207ac6f",
        },
        "old release is not reviewed no-ACT predecessor",
    )
    _need(
        # An authenticated pre-effect failure can need fresh operational inputs,
        # not new source. The forensic/quiescence checks below still apply.
        generic_pre_effect or old.get("candidate_sha") != new.get("candidate_sha"),
        "source candidate release is not different",
    )
    if old.get("candidate_sha") == new.get("candidate_sha"):
        _need(
            old.get("modules") == new.get("modules"),
            "same-source recovery changed immutable source closure",
        )
    release = _installed_release(new_release_journal, new["candidate_sha"])
    _need(
        new.get("modules", {}).get(Path(__file__).name) == _sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
        "new manifest does not pin executing source-upgrade boundary",
    )
    reference = (
        _source_selection_pre_effect_reference(old_path, old_state, worker_id)
        if generic_pre_effect
        else _old_reference(old_path, old_state, worker_id)[0]
    )
    pagination_preinstruction = old.get("candidate_sha") == REVIEWED_PAGINATION_CANDIDATE
    if generic_pre_effect:
        diagnostic = reference["forensic"]
    elif failed_before_pipeline:
        _need(
            _sha(old_raw) == reference["manifest_sha256"] and old == reference["manifest"],
            "failed-before-pipeline old manifest changed during reader validation",
        )
    _same_identity(old, new)
    (_generic_old_native_quiescent if generic_pre_effect else _old_native_terminal)(old)
    host._lane_absent()
    custody = _old_custody_quiet(old)
    index = fresh_read_native_index(
        old["policy"]["correction_controller_installation"]["config"], custody
    )
    if failed_before_pipeline:
        diagnostic = {
            "schema": "failed-before-pipeline-readback/v1",
            "authority": False,
            "accepted": False,
            "retry_authority": False,
            "result_sha256": reference["result_sha256"],
            "terminal_sha256": reference["terminal_sha256"],
            "handoff_sha256": reference["handoff_sha256"],
        }
    elif generic_pre_effect:
        # The sealed forensic reader above is deliberately post-CAS safe.
        # Do not invoke the literal reviewed-predecessor diagnostic here.
        _need(
            diagnostic.get("schema") == "source-selection-pre-effect-forensic/v1"
            and diagnostic.get("authority") is False,
            "generic pre-effect diagnostic differs",
        )
    elif pagination_preinstruction:
        # This validates an old-source closure and an immutable failure frame,
        # but intentionally leaves its uncertain operation and reservations in
        # place. It is not a completion proof and cannot authorize a replay.
        _old_module_bytes(old)
        diagnostic = _pagination_preinstruction_diagnostic(reference)
        _need(
            diagnostic.get("pre_instruction_proven") is True
            and reference["state_sha256"] == _sha(host._read(Path(reference["state_path"]))[1])
            and reference["result_sha256"] == REVIEWED_PAGINATION_RESULT_SHA256,
            "pagination old-source diagnostic differs",
        )
    else:
        interpreter = Path(old["mechanism_contract"]["interpreter"]["path"])
        diagnostic = _old_diagnostic(
            old_path, Path(reference["state_path"]), worker_id, interpreter=interpreter
        )
        _need(
            diagnostic.get("state_sha256") == reference["state_sha256"],
            "old diagnostic campaign differs from captured reference",
        )
        _need(
            diagnostic.get("worker_target") == reference["worker"].get("target")
            and diagnostic.get("source_target")
            in reference["state"]["worker_config"]["finite_frontier"]["targets"],
            "old diagnostic scopes differ",
        )
        cohort, completed = diagnostic.get("cohort"), diagnostic.get("completed_round")
        if not all(isinstance(value, dict) for value in (cohort, completed)):
            raise SourceUpgradeHeld("old diagnostic shape invalid")
        _diagnostic_no_act(old["candidate_sha"], diagnostic)
        _incomplete_cohort(cast(dict[str, Any], cohort), cast(dict[str, Any], completed))
    state = _canonical(new_state)
    _need(
        not state.exists()
        and state.parent == _canonical(new["mechanism_contract"]["campaign_root"]),
        "new state is not fresh current campaign",
    )
    # Freeze the only proposed inputs before CAS. These remain non-authoritative
    # until the later current-source admission path observes demand again.
    import closer_frontier_policy as policy
    import closer_native_readmission as readmission

    try:
        fresh = policy.validate_frontier(frontier, targets=frontier.get("targets"))
        old_frontier = policy.validate_frontier(
            reference["state"]["worker_config"]["finite_frontier"]
        )
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise SourceUpgradeHeld("pre-CAS frontier invalid") from exc
    cfg = _physical_recipe(
        reference["state"]["worker_config"],
        reference["state"],
        old["policy"],
        Path(reference["state_path"]),
        new,
        new_path,
        state,
        fresh,
    )
    supplied = json.loads(json.dumps(new_worker_config, sort_keys=True))
    _need(supplied == cfg, "pre-CAS worker config is not strict old-to-new rebind")
    new_custody = _inert_new_custody(new, state, custody["highwater"]["anchor"])
    _need(
        cfg.get("granularity", "round") == "round"
        and cfg.get("mechanism") == "native-handoff/v1"
        and cfg.get("execution_policy") == "finite-frontier/v2"
        and cfg.get("dispatch_workers") == 1
        and cfg.get("coordinator_mode") == "resource_scoped"
        and isinstance(cfg.get("coordinator_contract_pin"), dict),
        "strict rebind worker modes/coordinator differ",
    )
    hooks = cfg.get("native_hooks")
    _need(
        isinstance(hooks, dict)
        and hooks.get("bounded_no_new_relay") is True
        and isinstance(hooks.get("prerun"), dict)
        and isinstance(hooks.get("postrun"), dict)
        and isinstance(hooks.get("lease_module"), dict),
        "strict rebind native hooks invalid",
    )
    readmission._guard_fresh(new, cfg, state, fresh, old_frontier)
    receipt = _canonical(restore_receipt)
    wrapper = _wrapper_plan(old_path, old, new_path, new, receipt)
    _restored, predecessor = install._restored_predecessor(receipt)
    rows = install._prospective_rows(predecessor, reference, new, state)
    # The restore predecessor may be historical attempt13 rather than this
    # stopped worker. Its custody fence cannot stand in for either current
    # controller namespace.
    for inspection in (custody, new_custody):
        writer = str(Path(inspection["identity"]["custody_path"]) / "writer.lock")
        if not any(row["path"] == writer for row in rows):
            rows.append({"path": writer, "must_exist": True})
    rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["path"])
    result = {
        "schema": SCHEMA,
        "authority": False,
        "eligible": True,
        "producer_sha256": _sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
        "old": {
            "manifest": str(old_path),
            "manifest_sha256": _sha(old_raw),
            "state": reference["state_path"],
            "state_sha256": reference["state_sha256"],
            "result": reference["result_path"],
            "result_sha256": reference["result_sha256"],
            "custody": custody,
            "native_index": index,
            "diagnostic": diagnostic,
            "failed_before_pipeline": failed_before_pipeline,
            "generic_pre_effect": generic_pre_effect,
            "worker_id": worker_id,
        },
        "new": {
            "manifest": str(new_path),
            "manifest_sha256": _sha(new_raw),
            "state": str(state),
            "custody": new_custody,
        },
        "restore_receipt": {"path": str(receipt), "sha256": _sha(host._read(receipt)[1])},
        "new_release": release,
        "held_recipe": {
            "worker_config": cfg,
            "worker_config_sha256": _sha(
                json.dumps(cfg, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
            ),
            "frontier": fresh,
            "frontier_sha256": _sha(
                json.dumps(fresh, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
            ),
        },
        "wrapper": wrapper,
        "locks": rows,
        "seal": str(_upgrade_path(new, _SEAL_NAME)),
    }
    result["plan_sha256"] = _plan_sha(result)
    return result


def apply(
    old_manifest,
    old_state,
    worker_id,
    new_manifest,
    new_state,
    restore_receipt,
    new_worker_config,
    frontier,
    new_release_journal,
    *,
    expected_plan_sha256: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """One-way CAS after a sealed intent; it creates no campaign or native work."""
    import closer_native_wrapper_install as install

    inputs = (
        old_manifest,
        old_state,
        worker_id,
        new_manifest,
        new_state,
        restore_receipt,
        new_worker_config,
        frontier,
        new_release_journal,
    )
    first = plan(*inputs)
    _need(first["plan_sha256"] == expected_plan_sha256, "plan changed")
    with host._hold(first["locks"]):
        second = plan(*inputs)
        _need(second["plan_sha256"] == first["plan_sha256"], "plan changed under locks")
        new_path = Path(first["new"]["manifest"])
        _, new_raw, new = _manifest(new_path)
        _need(_sha(new_raw) == first["new"]["manifest_sha256"], "new manifest changed before CAS")
        seal = _upgrade_path(new, _SEAL_NAME)
        _need(str(seal) == first["seal"], "source upgrade seal path differs")
        intent = _upgrade_path(new, _INTENT_NAME)
        known_path = _upgrade_path(new, _KNOWN_NAME)
        _need(
            not known_path.exists(),
            "source upgrade already known",
        )
        _need(not intent.exists() or seal.exists(), "intent has no pre-CAS seal")
        # A fully fresh observation root has no supervisor key yet.  Once any
        # upgrade witness exists, recovery must verify it with the original
        # key rather than minting or replacing one.
        if not seal.exists() and not intent.exists():
            _provision_upgrade_key(new)
        if seal.exists():
            _seal_path, _seal_raw, prior_seal = _read_signed_upgrade(
                seal,
                new,
                name=_SEAL_NAME,
                label="pre-CAS source upgrade seal",
                manifest_sha256=_sha(new_raw),
            )
            _need(
                prior_seal.get("stage") == "sealed_pre_cas"
                and _plan_sha(prior_seal) == first["plan_sha256"]
                and prior_seal.get("plan_sha256") == first["plan_sha256"],
                "pre-CAS source upgrade records differ",
            )
        if intent.exists():
            _intent_path, _intent_raw, prior_intent = _read_signed_upgrade(
                intent,
                new,
                name=_INTENT_NAME,
                label="pre-CAS source upgrade intent",
                manifest_sha256=_sha(new_raw),
            )
            _need(
                prior_intent.get("stage") == "intent"
                and _plan_sha(prior_intent) == first["plan_sha256"]
                and prior_intent.get("plan_sha256") == first["plan_sha256"],
                "pre-CAS source upgrade records differ",
            )
        # Both records are immutable, and the seal intentionally precedes CAS:
        # after the wrapper changes, old native.contract would be circular.
        sealed = {**first, "stage": "sealed_pre_cas", "at": time.time()}
        _need(_plan_sha(sealed) == first["plan_sha256"], "plan body differs before seal")
        wrapper = Path(first["wrapper"]["path"])
        _need(
            _sha(host._read(wrapper)[1]) == first["wrapper"]["before_sha256"],
            "wrapper CAS preimage changed",
        )
        # Re-read the archived base through the installer helper; no old
        # contract is invoked after this point.
        receipt_path, receipt_raw = host._ref(first["restore_receipt"], "sealed_restore_receipt")
        _need(
            _sha(receipt_raw) == first["restore_receipt"]["sha256"],
            "sealed restore receipt changed",
        )
        restored_doc, _ = install._restored_predecessor(receipt_path)
        data = install._render(
            install._guard_source(install._archived_base(restored_doc)), new, new_path
        )
        _need(_sha(data) == first["wrapper"]["after_sha256"], "wrapper CAS render changed")
        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=wrapper.parent, prefix=".source-upgrade-wrapper-")
        replaced = False
        phase = "wrapper_readback"
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
                fd = -1
                stream.write(data)
                stream.flush()
                os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), 0o755)
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            # A valid seal without its later intent is recoverable only after
            # plan() reauthenticates the exact old wrapper and all facts above.
            # Partial or different existing records are never overwritten.
            if not seal.exists():
                host._write_once(seal, _signed_upgrade_record(new, sealed))
            if not intent.exists():
                host._write_once(
                    intent,
                    _signed_upgrade_record(new, {**first, "stage": "intent", "at": time.time()}),
                )
            os.replace(tmp, wrapper)
            replaced = True
            directory = os.open(wrapper.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
            try:
                os.fsync(directory)
            finally:
                os.close(directory)
            _need(
                _sha(host._read(wrapper)[1]) == first["wrapper"]["after_sha256"],
                "wrapper CAS readback failed",
            )
            # Current contract only: old contract is invalid by design now.
            import closer_native_observer as native

            phase = "native_contract"
            native.contract(new)
            phase = "wrapper_entry"
            native._check_wrapper_entry(new, new_path)
            # The only permitted post-CAS difference is the canonical wrapper.
            # Re-read every new module/source pin after replacement.
            phase = "module_closure"
            _, verified_raw, verified = _manifest(new_path)
            _need(
                _sha(verified_raw) == first["new"]["manifest_sha256"] and verified == new,
                "new source closure changed after wrapper CAS",
            )
            phase = "known_receipt_write"
            host._write_once(
                known_path,
                _signed_upgrade_record(
                    new,
                    {**first, "stage": "cas_known", "status": "installed", "at": time.time()},
                ),
            )
            return {**first, "status": "installed"}
        except Exception as exc:
            if replaced:
                raise SourceUpgradeHeld(
                    "post-CAS outcome uncertain: " + phase + ":" + type(exc).__name__
                ) from None
            raise
        finally:
            if fd >= 0:
                os.close(fd)
            try:
                Path(tmp).unlink()

            else:

                    old_manifest_path,
                    old_state,
                    old_worker_id,
                    manifest_sha256=record["old"]["manifest_sha256"],
                    state_sha256=record["old"]["state_sha256"],
                )
        _need(
            locked_reference["result_sha256"] == record["old"]["result_sha256"]
            and locked_reference["state_sha256"] == record["old"]["state_sha256"],
            "old predecessor changed under locks",
        )
        if generic_pre_effect:
            _need(
                locked_reference.get("forensic") == record["old"].get("diagnostic"),
                "generic pre-effect forensic evidence changed under locks",
            )
        (_generic_old_native_quiescent if generic_pre_effect else _old_native_terminal)(
            locked_old_manifest
        )
        host._lane_absent()
        _need(
            _old_custody_quiet(locked_old_manifest) == inspection,
            "old custody changed under locks",
        )
        _need(
            _inert_new_custody(manifest, destination, inspection["highwater"]["anchor"])
            == record["new"]["custody"],
            "new custody changed under locks",
        )
        _need(
            fresh_read_native_index(
                locked_old_manifest["policy"]["correction_controller_installation"]["config"],
                inspection,
            )
            == record["old"]["native_index"],
            "native index changed under locks",
        )
        _need(not destination.exists() and not marker.exists(), "fresh held state changed")
        reference = {
            "state_path": str(old_state),
            "state_sha256": record["old"]["state_sha256"],
            "worker": locked_reference["worker"],
            "result_path": str(old_result),
            "result_sha256": record["old"]["result_sha256"],
            # This is a sealed no-ACT disposition reference, never a fabricated
            # no-start proof; generic preparation only hashes it for provenance.
            "proof": {
                "schema": SCHEMA,
                "plan_sha256": confirm_plan_sha256,
                "diagnostic": record["old"]["diagnostic"],
            },
        }
        plan_doc, readmission_sha = readmission._plan(
            reference, new_path, raw, cfg, destination, fresh
        )
        token = readmission._intent_token(plan_doc, readmission_sha)
        intent = seal.with_name("source-upgrade-readmission-intent.json")
        known = readmission._recover_or_create(
            campaign,
            native,
            destination,
            manifest,
            cfg,
            fresh,
            old_doc,
            readmission_sha,
            intent,
            token,

        if created is None:
            raise SourceUpgradeHeld("known preparation did not create held campaign")
        host._write_once(
            marker,
            {
                "schema": SCHEMA,
                "seal_sha256": _sha(seal_raw),
                "state": str(destination),
                "revision": created["revision"],
                "known": str(known),
                "authority": False,
            },
        )
    return {
        "status": "fresh_held_prepared",
        "authority": False,
        "state": str(destination),
        "revision": created["revision"],
        "marker": str(marker),
    }

        not isinstance(raw, list)
        or not raw
        or not all(isinstance(row, dict) and isinstance(row.get("raw"), dict) for row in raw)
        or any(row.get("finding_id") != closer_disposition._finding_id(row["raw"]) for row in raw)
        or not any(
            row["raw"] == {"source": "native_verifier", "verdict": "NON_PASS", "raw": verifier}
            for row in raw
        )
        or not isinstance(resolutions, list)
        or not all(isinstance(row, dict) for row in resolutions)
        or sorted(row.get("finding_id", "") for row in resolutions)
        != sorted(row["finding_id"] for row in raw)
        or not isinstance(actions, list)
        or actions != [row.get("next_guarded_action") for row in resolutions]
        or any(action not in {"wait", "collect_evidence"} for action in actions)
    ):
        return False
    return all(
        row.get("status")
        in {
            "unresolved_missing_evidence",
            "unresolved_mechanical",
            "resolved_duplicate",
            "resolved_nonissue",
        }
        and (
            not row["status"].startswith("unresolved_")
            or (isinstance(row.get("reason"), str) and bool(row["reason"].strip()))
        )
        for row in resolutions
    )


EVIDENCE_REFUSAL_REASONS = frozenset(
    {"substantive_or_ambiguous_finding", "source_coverage_incomplete"}
)
EVIDENCE_REFUSAL_TRIGGER = "source owner supplies current-head proof or resolves the named finding"


def _valid_inner_wait(
    pipeline_path: Path,
    target: str,
    revision: Any,
    snapshot: Any,
    reason: Any,
    trigger: Any,
    proof: Any,
    *,
    frontier_id: str | None = None,
    finite_frontier: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    now: Callable[[], float] = time.time,
) -> bool:
    """Bind a terminal inner wait to its durable, current one-target receipt."""
    if not isinstance(snapshot, Mapping) or not isinstance(proof, Mapping):
        return False
    head = snapshot.get("head")
    if (
        proof.get("schema") != INNER_WAIT_SCHEMA
        or proof.get("target") != target
        or proof.get("revision") != revision
        or proof.get("head") != head
        or snapshot.get("target") != target
        or snapshot.get("revision") != revision
        or not isinstance(revision, str)
        or not revision
        or not isinstance(reason, str)
        or not isinstance(trigger, str)
        or not trigger.strip()
        or proof.get("reason") != reason
        or proof.get("next_trigger") != trigger
        or not isinstance(proof.get("receipt_sha256"), str)
        or len(proof["receipt_sha256"]) != 64
    ):
        return False
    if head is None:
        if snapshot.get("kind") != "issue":
            return False
    elif (
        not isinstance(head, str)
        or len(head) != 40
        or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in head)
    ):
        return False
    if reason == "worker_json_invalid" or reason in EVIDENCE_REFUSAL_REASONS:
        if trigger != EVIDENCE_REFUSAL_TRIGGER:
            return False
    elif reason.startswith("current item-scoped hold: "):
        if trigger == "wait_for_trigger" or trigger == "resume_target_from_current_evidence":
            return False
    elif reason.startswith(NONPASS_WAIT_PREFIX):
        if not isinstance(proof.get("ordinary_nonpass_ref"), Mapping):
            return False
    else:
        return False

    import closer_queue

    proof_frontier_id = proof.get("frontier_id")
    proof_frontier = proof.get("finite_frontier")
    if (
        frontier_id is not None and (not isinstance(frontier_id, str) or not frontier_id.strip())
    ) or (
        proof_frontier_id is not None
        and (not isinstance(proof_frontier_id, str) or not proof_frontier_id.strip())
    ):
        return False
    if frontier_id is not None and proof_frontier_id not in {None, frontier_id}:
        return False
    selected_frontier_id = frontier_id or proof_frontier_id
    if selected_frontier_id is not None and (
        not isinstance(selected_frontier_id, str) or not selected_frontier_id.strip()
    ):
        return False
    if selected_frontier_id is not None and (
        not isinstance(proof_frontier, Mapping)
        or proof_frontier.get("frontier_id") != selected_frontier_id
        or (finite_frontier is not None and dict(proof_frontier) != dict(finite_frontier))
    ):
        return False
    inner_path = pipeline_path.parent / f"{pipeline_path.stem}.actions" / f"{_digest(target)}.json"
    if proof.get("inner_path") != str(inner_path) or not inner_path.is_file():
        return False
    try:
        with closer_queue._ledger_lock(inner_path, cutoff=float(now()) + 1, now=now) as locked:
            if not locked:
                return False
            state = closer_queue._read_state(inner_path)
            if selected_frontier_id is None:
                round_state = state.get("round", {})
                items = state.get("items", {})
                validation_state = state
            else:
                selected_state = closer_queue.state_for_frontier(
                    state,
                    selected_frontier_id,
                    expected_policy=finite_frontier or proof_frontier,
                )
                if selected_state is None:
                    return False
                validation_state = selected_state
                round_state = validation_state["round"]
                items = validation_state["items"]
            receipt = round_state.get("receipt")
            item = items.get(target) if isinstance(items, Mapping) else None
            if not isinstance(receipt, Mapping) or not isinstance(item, Mapping):
                return False
            checked = closer_queue._validate_data(
                validation_state,
                receipt,
                assignment_targets=[target],
                now_value=float(now()),
                holder_fn=closer_queue.claims.holder,
            )
            if not checked.get("stop_valid") or not checked.get("valid"):
                return False
            rows = receipt.get("accounting")
            if (
                round_state.get("status") != "finished"
                or receipt.get("schema") != closer_queue.RECEIPT_SCHEMA
                or receipt.get("stop_valid") is not True
                or receipt.get("assignment_targets") != [target]
                or not isinstance(rows, list)
                or len(rows) != 1
                or rows[0] != closer_queue._account_row(target, item)
                or _digest(receipt) != proof["receipt_sha256"]
                or round_state.get("source_revisions", {}).get(target) != revision
            ):
                return False
            row = rows[0]
            if (
                row.get("target") != target
                or row.get("revision") != revision
                or row.get("action") != "wait"
                or row.get("eligible") is not False
                or row.get("requires_coordinator") is not False
                or row.get("status") not in {"deferred", "ineligible"}
                or row.get("reason") != reason
                or row.get("next_trigger") != trigger
                or row.get("observation_freshness") != "fresh"
                or row.get("operation_id") is not None
                or row.get("operation_status") is not None
                or item.get("evidence", {}).get("head") != head
            ):
                return False
            history = item.get("operation_history", [])
            if not isinstance(history, list):
                return False
            if reason in EVIDENCE_REFUSAL_REASONS and (
                item.get("operation") is not None
                or history
                or receipt.get("progress") != []
                or receipt.get("eligible_remaining") != []
            ):
                # A refusal is durable scheduling evidence only. It cannot
                # reconcile an operation or establish criterion acceptance.
                return False
            for operation in [item.get("operation"), *history]:
                if operation is None:
                    continue
                if not isinstance(operation, Mapping) or operation.get("status") not in {
                    "completed",
                    "failed",
                    "confirmed_not_started",
                    "abandoned",
                }:
                    return False
            if reason.startswith("current item-scoped hold: "):
                labels = set(item.get("evidence", {}).get("labels", []))
                for source in item.get("evidence", {}).get("sources", []):
                    if isinstance(source, Mapping):
                        labels.update(source.get("labels", []))
                holds = labels.intersection(
                    {
                        "agents:auto-pilot-pause",
                        "agents:paused",
                        "agent:paused",
                        "do-not-merge",
                        "hold",
                        "needs-human",
                    }
                )
                if reason != f"current item-scoped hold: {sorted(holds)}" or not holds:
                    return False
            elif reason.startswith(NONPASS_WAIT_PREFIX):
                import closer_disposition

                raw = closer_disposition._safe_raw(
                    proof.get("ordinary_nonpass_ref"), _nonpass_wait_store(pipeline_path)
                )
                if raw is None or not _valid_nonpass_wait_record(
                    json.loads(raw), target, revision, item.get("evidence"), reason, trigger
                ):
                    return False
            return True
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
        return False


def _semantic_cache_token(prepare: Any) -> str | None:
    """Accept only the producer's explicit versioned semantic binding."""
    if not isinstance(prepare, Mapping):
        return None
    value = prepare.get("semantic_cache_key")
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.startswith(SEMANTIC_CACHE_PREFIX):
        return None
    digest = value[len(SEMANTIC_CACHE_PREFIX) :]
    if len(digest) != 64 or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in digest):
        return None
    return value


def _correction_enrollment_boundary(path, target, item, frontier, run_id, result=None):
    """Re-read protected source issuance; a pending status is insufficient."""
    result = item.get("results", {}).get("act") if result is None else result
    for value in (item, result, item.get("results", {}).get("act")):
        if isinstance(value, Mapping) and (
            value.get("recovery_barrier") is not None
            or any(
                value.get(flag) is not None and value.get(flag) is not False
                for flag in ("outcome_uncertain", "provider_outcome_uncertain")
            )
        ):
            return None
    if not (
        isinstance(result, Mapping)
        and result.get("status") == "pending"
        and result.get("pending_kind") == "source_correction_enrollment"
        and result.get("reason") == "correction_enrollment_terminal"
        and result.get("target_complete") is False
        and item.get("recovery_barrier") is None
        and item.get("provider_outcome_uncertain") in (None, False)
    ):
        return None
    try:
        import closer_correction_enrollment_terminal as enrollment_terminal

        path = Path(path)
        action_path = path.parent / f"{path.stem}.actions" / f"{_digest(target)}.json"
        expected_stage = {
            "pipeline_state_path": str(path),
            "pipeline_run_id": run_id,
            "work_key": item["work_key"],
            "identity": item["identity"],
            "revision": item["revision"],
            "action_state_path": str(action_path),
        }
        proof = enrollment_terminal.validate_queue_boundary(
            manifest_path=result["enrollment_manifest_path"],
            state_path=str(action_path),
            target=target,
            finite_frontier=frontier,
            proof_ref=result["correction_enrollment_terminal"],
            expected_stage=expected_stage,
        )
        return proof if proof is not None and proof == result.get("pending_evidence") else None
    except (ImportError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
        return None


def _valid_worker_capacity(resource: Any, now_value: float) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(resource, Mapping):
        return False
    capacity = resource.get("capacity")
    if not isinstance(capacity, Mapping) or capacity.get("lane") not in CEILINGS:
        return False
    sampled_at = capacity.get("sampled_at")
    if (
        not isinstance(sampled_at, (int, float))
        or isinstance(sampled_at, bool)
        or not math.isfinite(float(sampled_at))
        or not 0 <= now_value - float(sampled_at) <= 1800
    ):
        return False
    active = capacity.get("active")
    limit = capacity.get("limit")
    if type(active) is int and type(limit) is int and limit > 0 and active >= limit:
        return True
    required = capacity.get("required")
    return capacity.get("available") == 0 and type(required) is int and required > 0


def _valid_provider_failure(resource: Any) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(resource, Mapping):
        return False
    failure = resource.get("provider_failure")
    if not isinstance(failure, Mapping):
        return False
    for field in ("profile_id", "agent", "run_id", "category", "evidence_hash"):
        value = failure.get(field)
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
            return False
    exit_code = failure.get("exit")
    return type(exit_code) is int and exit_code != 0


def _valid_uncertain_provider_outcome(value: Any, target: str, item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or value.get("status") != "uncertain":
        return False
    outcome = value.get("provider_outcome")
    if not isinstance(outcome, Mapping) or outcome.get("schema") != (
        "closer-provider-outcome-uncertain/v1"
    ):
        return False
    head = outcome.get("head")
    revision = item.get("revision")
    if (
        outcome.get("target") != target
        or not isinstance(revision, str)
        or not revision.strip()
        or outcome.get("revision") != revision
        or outcome.get("identity") != item.get("identity", target)
    ):
        return False
    prepared = item.get("results", {}).get("prepare", {})
    if not isinstance(prepared, Mapping):
        return False
    snapshot = prepared.get("snapshot")
    if not isinstance(snapshot, Mapping):
        return False
    if head is None:
        # Standalone issue snapshots have no PR head. Their exact preparation
        # revision plus target/identity is the binding that survives a restart.
        if snapshot.get("kind") != "issue" or snapshot.get("head") is not None:
            return False
    elif (
        not isinstance(head, str)
        or len(head) != 40
        or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in head)
        or snapshot.get("head") != head
    ):
        return False
    semantic = _semantic_cache_token(prepared)
    if not semantic or outcome.get("semantic_cache_key") != semantic:
        return False
    actual = outcome.get("actual")
    if not isinstance(actual, Mapping):
        return False
    identities = [actual.get(field) for field in ("agent", "requested_profile", "run_id")]
    return (
        all(isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()) for value in identities)
        and type(actual.get("exit")) is int
        and actual.get("exit") != 0
        and actual.get("outcome_status") == "uncertain"
        and actual.get("retry_safe") is False
    )


def _valid_deadline_evidence(resource: Any, deadline: float, rows: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(resource, Mapping) or resource.get("deadline") != deadline:
        return False
    observed = resource.get("observed_at")
    if not isinstance(observed, (int, float)) or isinstance(observed, bool) or observed < deadline:
        return False
    if resource.get("type") == "active_deadline":
        return True
    if resource.get("type") != "round_deadline_exhausted":
        return False
    reported = resource.get("reported_deadline")
    remaining = resource.get("remaining_seconds")
    source = resource.get("source_target")
    return (
        isinstance(reported, (int, float))
        and not isinstance(reported, bool)
        and abs(float(reported) - deadline) <= 0.01
        and isinstance(remaining, (int, float))
        and not isinstance(remaining, bool)
        and math.isfinite(float(remaining))
        and float(remaining) < 2
        and isinstance(source, str)
        and source in rows
    )


def _valid_github_capacity_evidence(resource: Any, now_value: float) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(resource, Mapping):
        return False
    capacity = resource.get("github_capacity")
    if not isinstance(capacity, Mapping):
        return False
    throttle = capacity.get("throttle")
    if not isinstance(throttle, Mapping):
        return False
    observed = capacity.get("observed_at")
    reset_at = capacity.get("reset_at_epoch")
    resource_name = capacity.get("resource")
    reset_in = throttle.get("reset_in_s")
    remaining = throttle.get("remaining")
    limit = throttle.get("limit")
    return (
        throttle.get("state") == "shed"
        and throttle.get("action") == "defer"
        and isinstance(throttle.get("resource"), str)
        and bool(throttle.get("resource"))
        and resource_name == throttle.get("resource")
        and isinstance(throttle.get("reason"), str)
        and bool(throttle.get("reason"))
        and isinstance(throttle.get("source"), str)
        and bool(throttle.get("source"))
        and type(remaining) is int
        and remaining >= 0
        and type(limit) is int
        and limit > 0
        and type(reset_in) is int
        and reset_in > 0
        and isinstance(observed, (int, float))
        and not isinstance(observed, bool)
        and math.isfinite(float(observed))
        and 0 <= now_value - float(observed) <= 1800
        and isinstance(reset_at, (int, float))
        and not isinstance(reset_at, bool)
        and math.isfinite(float(reset_at))
        and abs(float(reset_at) - (float(observed) + reset_in)) <= 1
        and float(reset_at) > now_value
    )


def _bounded(value: Any, *, limit: int = 128 * 1024) -> Any:
    encoded = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    if len(encoded.encode()) > limit:
        raise ValueError(f"pipeline JSON exceeds {limit} bytes")
    return json.loads(encoded)


AUDIT_ARCHIVE_SCHEMA = "closer-invalid-stop-audit-archive/v1"
NATIVE_WAIT_AUDIT_SCHEMA = "closer-native-wait-continuation-audit/v1"


def _audit_archive_dir(path: Path) -> Path:
    return path.with_name(path.name + ".audit")


def _archived_history(path: Path, reference: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Verify every state-owned immutable audit chunk before relying on it."""
    if reference is None:
        return []
    if (
        not isinstance(reference, Mapping)
        or reference.get("schema") != AUDIT_ARCHIVE_SCHEMA
        or not isinstance(reference.get("sha256"), str)
        or type(reference.get("count")) is not int
        or reference["count"] < 1
    ):
        raise ValueError("invalid pipeline audit archive reference")
    directory = _audit_archive_dir(path)
    if directory.is_symlink() or not directory.is_dir():
        raise ValueError("missing or redirected pipeline audit archive")
    sha = reference["sha256"]
    seen: set[str] = set()
    chunks: list[list[dict[str, Any]]] = []
    total = 0
    while sha is not None:
        if (
            not isinstance(sha, str)
            or len(sha) != 64
            or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in sha)
            or sha in seen
            or len(seen) >= 100_000
        ):
            raise ValueError("invalid pipeline audit archive chain")
        seen.add(sha)
        source = directory / f"{sha}.json"
        if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file():
            raise ValueError("missing or redirected pipeline audit archive chunk")
        raw = source.read_bytes()
        if len(raw) > 1024 * 1024 or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != sha:
            raise ValueError("tampered pipeline audit archive chunk")
        try:
            chunk = json.loads(raw)
        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
            raise ValueError("malformed pipeline audit archive chunk") from exc
        entries = chunk.get("entries") if isinstance(chunk, Mapping) else None
        if (
            not isinstance(chunk, Mapping)
            or chunk.get("schema") != AUDIT_ARCHIVE_SCHEMA
            or not isinstance(entries, list)
            or not entries
            or not all(isinstance(entry, dict) for entry in entries)
        ):
            raise ValueError("invalid pipeline audit archive chunk")
        total += len(entries)
        if total > reference["count"]:
            raise ValueError("pipeline audit archive count mismatch")
        chunks.append(entries)
        sha = chunk.get("previous_sha256")
    if total != reference["count"]:
        raise ValueError("pipeline audit archive count mismatch")
    return [entry for chunk in reversed(chunks) for entry in chunk]


def _resolved_audit_history(path: Path, previous: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    local = previous.get("invalid_stop_history", [])
    if not isinstance(local, list) or not all(isinstance(entry, dict) for entry in local):
        raise ValueError("invalid pipeline audit history")
    archived = _archived_history(path, previous.get("invalid_stop_archive"))
    if archived and (
        not local
        or local[0].get("schema")
        not in {"closer-expired-invalid-round-recovery/v1", NATIVE_WAIT_AUDIT_SCHEMA}
    ):
        raise ValueError("pipeline audit archive lost its origin")
    return local[:1] + archived + local[1:] if archived else local


def _stage_audit_history(
    path: Path,
    previous: Mapping[str, Any],
    new_entry: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any] | None]:
    """Archive overflow first; the caller then atomically saves the new ledger ref."""
    _resolved_audit_history(path, previous)
    local = list(previous.get("invalid_stop_history", []))
    if new_entry is not None:
        local.append(dict(new_entry))
    reference = previous.get("invalid_stop_archive")
    try:
        _bounded(local, limit=512 * 1024)
        return local, dict(reference) if isinstance(reference, Mapping) else None
    except ValueError:
        if len(local) < 2:
            raise
    entries = local[1:]
    previous_sha = reference.get("sha256") if isinstance(reference, Mapping) else None
    chunk = {
        "schema": AUDIT_ARCHIVE_SCHEMA,
        "previous_sha256": previous_sha,
        "entries": entries,
    }
    raw = _canonical(chunk)
    if len(raw) > 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("pipeline audit archive chunk too large")
    sha = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    directory = _audit_archive_dir(path)
    if directory.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("redirected pipeline audit archive")
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination = directory / f"{sha}.json"
    if destination.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("redirected pipeline audit archive chunk")
    if destination.exists():
        if destination.read_bytes() != raw:
            raise ValueError("conflicting pipeline audit archive chunk")
    else:
        fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".audit-", suffix=".tmp", dir=directory)
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
                stream.write(raw)
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            os.replace(temporary, destination)
            dfd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY)
            try:
                os.fsync(dfd)
            finally:
                os.close(dfd)
        finally:
            with contextlib.suppress(FileNotFoundError):
                os.unlink(temporary)
    count = (reference.get("count", 0) if isinstance(reference, Mapping) else 0) + len(entries)
    return local[:1], {"schema": AUDIT_ARCHIVE_SCHEMA, "sha256": sha, "count": count}


def _carry_item(item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Retain only facts needed to resume/reconcile across generations."""
    if item.get("deferred_reason") == "scope_quarantined":
        # A not-started proof binds the full inputs and the exact original row.
        # Compacting it would destroy the only lineage permitting fresh admission.
        return _bounded(item, limit=CALLBACK_CONTEXT_BYTES)
    keys = (
        "status",
        "stage",
        "revision",
        "identity",
        "owner",
        "progress_key",
        "transitions",
        "work_key",
        "metrics",
        "error",
        "deferred_reason",
        "deferred_next_trigger",
        "pending_kind",
        "pending_evidence",
        "resource_evidence",
        "provider_outcome_uncertain",
        "recovery_barrier",
        "recovery_excluded",
        "known_completed_action",
        "carried",
        "scope_proof",
    )
    carried = {key: item[key] for key in keys if key in item}
    results: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if item.get("status") == "uncertain" and item.get("stage") in {"interpret", "exception"}:
        outcome = item.get("provider_outcome_uncertain")
        if isinstance(outcome, Mapping):
            prepared = item.get("results", {}).get("prepare", {})
            prepared_snapshot = prepared.get("snapshot") if isinstance(prepared, Mapping) else None
            kind = prepared_snapshot.get("kind") if isinstance(prepared_snapshot, Mapping) else None
            results["prepare"] = {
                "revision": item.get("revision"),
                "identity": item.get("identity"),
                "semantic_cache_key": outcome.get("semantic_cache_key"),
                "snapshot": {"head": outcome.get("head"), "kind": kind},
            }
    return {**carried, "results": results}


def _retained_blocked_act_wait_proof(path: Path, target: str, item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """Validate a retained blocked action as an actual non-mutating inner wait."""
    results = item.get("results")
    if not isinstance(results, Mapping):
        return False
    act = results.get("act")
    prepared = results.get("prepare")
    if not isinstance(act, Mapping) or not isinstance(prepared, Mapping):
        return False
    receipt = act.get("queue_receipt")
    if (
        act.get("status") != "blocked"
        or not isinstance(receipt, Mapping)
        or receipt.get("schema") != "closer-queue-receipt/v1"
        or receipt.get("stop_valid") is not True
        or receipt.get("valid") is not True
    ):
        return False
    rows = receipt.get("accounting")
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or len(rows) != 1 or not isinstance(rows[0], Mapping):
        return False
    row = rows[0]
    reason, trigger = row.get("reason"), row.get("next_trigger")
    if act.get("reason") != reason or act.get("next_trigger") != trigger:
        return False
    if (
        isinstance(reason, str)
        and reason in EVIDENCE_REFUSAL_REASONS
        and (item.get("provider_outcome_uncertain") or item.get("known_completed_action") is True)
    ):
        return False
    inner_path = path.parent / f"{path.stem}.actions" / f"{_digest(target)}.json"
    snapshot = prepared.get("snapshot")
    proof = {
        "schema": INNER_WAIT_SCHEMA,
        "target": target,
        "revision": item.get("revision"),
        "head": snapshot.get("head") if isinstance(snapshot, Mapping) else None,
        "reason": reason,
        "next_trigger": trigger,
        "inner_path": str(inner_path),
        "receipt_sha256": _digest(receipt),
    }
    return _valid_inner_wait(path, target, item.get("revision"), snapshot, reason, trigger, proof)


def _legacy_failed_act_wait_proof(path: Path, target: str, item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """Recover only the pre-fix adapter failure backed by its original inner receipt."""
    return (
        item.get("status") == "failed"
        and item.get("stage") == "act"
        and item.get("error") == "act returned unsupported or missing status"
        and _retained_blocked_act_wait_proof(path, target, item)
    )


def _validated_wait_audit_origin(history, target, item):
    """Find the immutable origin for an already native-validated retained wait."""
    results = item.get("results")
    act = results.get("act") if isinstance(results, Mapping) else None
    if (
        not isinstance(act, Mapping)
        or not isinstance(item.get("identity"), str)
        or not item["identity"].strip()
        or not isinstance(item.get("revision"), str)
        or not item["revision"]
    ):
        return None
    for record in history:
        if not isinstance(record, Mapping):
            continue
        if record.get("schema") not in {
            "closer-expired-invalid-round-recovery/v1",
            NATIVE_WAIT_AUDIT_SCHEMA,
        }:
            continue
        source = record.get("source_run_id")
        rows = record.get("targets")
        row = rows.get(target) if isinstance(rows, Mapping) else None
        digest = row.get("item_sha256") if isinstance(row, Mapping) else None
        if (
            isinstance(source, str)
            and bool(source.strip())
            and isinstance(digest, str)
            and len(digest) == 64
            and all(char in "0123456789abcdef" for char in digest)
            and row.get("recovery") == "validated_inner_wait"
            and row.get("act_result") == act
            and row.get("revision") == item.get("revision")
            and row.get("identity") == item.get("identity")
        ):
            return {"previous_run_id": source, "previous_item_sha256": digest}
    return None


def _native_wait_origin_record(path, target, item, previous, source_run_id, prior_stop, now):
    """Record a current observed no-operation boundary; never label it expired."""
    if (
        item.get("known_completed_action") is True
        or item.get("provider_outcome_uncertain")
        or item.get("recovery_barrier") is not None
        or not _legacy_failed_act_wait_proof(path, target, item)
    ):
        return None
    try:
        act = _bounded(item["results"]["act"], limit=CALLBACK_RESULT_BYTES)
        row = {
            "item_sha256": _digest(item),
            "status": item.get("status"),
            "stage": item.get("stage"),
            "revision": item.get("revision"),
            "identity": item.get("identity"),
            "work_key": item.get("work_key"),
            "error": item.get("error"),
            "resource_evidence": item.get("resource_evidence"),
            "provider_outcome_uncertain": item.get("provider_outcome_uncertain"),
            "recovery_barrier": item.get("recovery_barrier"),
            "act_result": act,
            "act_receipt_sha256": _digest(act["queue_receipt"]),
            "recovery": "validated_inner_wait",
        }
        return _bounded(
            {
                "schema": NATIVE_WAIT_AUDIT_SCHEMA,
                "boundary": "validated_nonmutating_native_wait",
                "acceptance_authority": False,
                "source_run_id": source_run_id,
                "source_created": previous.get("created"),
                "source_deadline": previous.get("deadline"),
                "source_assignment": list(previous.get("assignment", [])),
                "recorded_at": now(),
                "prior_stop": prior_stop,
                "targets": {target: row},
            },
            limit=512 * 1024,
        )
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
        return None


def _historical_validated_wait_result(
    previous: Mapping[str, Any],
    target: str,
    item: Mapping[str, Any],
    history: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> bool:
    """Identify a stale, audited non-mutating action behind a fresh read result."""
    results = item.get("results")
    if not isinstance(results, Mapping):
        return False
    prepared = results.get("prepare")
    act_result = results.get("act")
    recovered = previous.get("prior_invalid_stop_evidence")
    return (
        isinstance(prepared, Mapping)
        and prepared.get("revision") == item.get("revision")
        and isinstance(act_result, Mapping)
        and isinstance(recovered, Mapping)
        and target in recovered.get("recovered_inner_wait_targets", [])
        and any(
            isinstance(record, Mapping)
            and isinstance(record.get("targets"), Mapping)
            and isinstance(record["targets"].get(target), Mapping)
            and record["targets"][target].get("recovery") == "validated_inner_wait"
            and record["targets"][target].get("act_result") == act_result
            and record["targets"][target].get("revision") != item.get("revision")
            for record in history
        )
    )


def _audited_retained_wait(
    path: Path,
    previous: Mapping[str, Any],
    target: str,
    item: Mapping[str, Any],
    history: list[dict[str, Any]],
    historical_now: float,
    source_run_id: str,
) -> bool:
    """Prove an original no-operation wait for read retry or origin preservation.

    A current act/validated_inner_wait row is accepted only so the constructor
    can retain its audited origin when admitting a later read cadence.
    """
    results = item.get("results")
    recovered = previous.get("prior_invalid_stop_evidence")
    recovery = previous.get("recovered_invalid_stop")
    summary = previous.get("receipt_summary")
    finished_at = summary.get("finished_at") if isinstance(summary, Mapping) else None
    # This new failed-read route requires an actual matching terminal receipt;
    # the older deferred-resource paths retain their existing time fallback.
    failed_read_terminal_proven = (
        isinstance(summary, Mapping)
        and summary.get("schema") == "closer-pipeline-receipt/v1"
        and summary.get("run_id") == source_run_id
        and summary.get("deadline") == previous.get("deadline")
        and isinstance(finished_at, (int, float))
        and not isinstance(finished_at, bool)
        and math.isfinite(float(finished_at))
        and float(previous["created"])
        <= float(previous["deadline"])
        <= float(finished_at)
        <= historical_now
    )
    anchor = (
        recovery.get("targets", {}).get(target)
        if isinstance(recovery, Mapping) and isinstance(recovery.get("targets"), Mapping)
        else None
    )
    if (
        not (
            (
                item.get("status") == "deferred"
                and (
                    (
                        item.get("stage") in {"prepare", "interpret", "exception"}
                        and item.get("deferred_reason")
                        in {
                            "deadline_exhausted",
                            "worker_capacity",
                            "provider_failure",
                            "github_capacity",
                        }
                    )
                    or (
                        item.get("stage") == "act"
                        and item.get("deferred_reason") == "validated_inner_wait"
                    )
                )
            )
            or (
                item.get("status") == "failed"
                and item.get("stage") == "interpret"
                and item.get("error") == PRELAUNCH_ROUTE_BUSY_ERROR
                and failed_read_terminal_proven
            )
            or _interrupted_read(previous, item)
        )
        or item.get("known_completed_action") is True
        or item.get("provider_outcome_uncertain")
        or not isinstance(results, Mapping)
        or not isinstance(recovered, Mapping)
        or not isinstance(recovered.get("recovered_inner_wait_targets"), list)
        or not all(
            isinstance(value, str) and value for value in recovered["recovered_inner_wait_targets"]
        )
        or target not in recovered.get("recovered_inner_wait_targets", [])
        or not isinstance(recovery, Mapping)
        or recovery.get("schema") != "closer-recovered-inner-wait/v1"
        or not isinstance(recovery.get("previous_run_id"), str)
        or not recovery["previous_run_id"].strip()
        or not isinstance(anchor, Mapping)
        or not isinstance(anchor.get("previous_run_id", recovery["previous_run_id"]), str)
        or not anchor.get("previous_run_id", recovery["previous_run_id"]).strip()
        or not isinstance(anchor.get("previous_item_sha256"), str)
        or len(anchor["previous_item_sha256"]) != 64
        or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in anchor["previous_item_sha256"])
    ):
        return False
    prepared, act = results.get("prepare"), results.get("act")
    if not isinstance(prepared, Mapping) or not isinstance(act, Mapping):
        return False
    if act.get("status") == "blocked":
        # A compact pre-fix refusal can be restored as scheduling proof, then
        # encounter a new read-only capacity/deadline boundary. Preserve that
        # same immutable native refusal across the next cadence; it still has
        # no acceptance or action authority.
        receipt = act.get("queue_receipt")
        snapshot = prepared.get("snapshot")
        if (
            not isinstance(act.get("reason"), str)
            or act.get("reason") not in EVIDENCE_REFUSAL_REASONS
            or act.get("next_trigger") != EVIDENCE_REFUSAL_TRIGGER
            or not isinstance(receipt, Mapping)
            or not isinstance(snapshot, Mapping)
            or prepared.get("revision", snapshot.get("revision")) != item.get("revision")
            or snapshot.get("revision") != item.get("revision")
            or anchor.get("revision") != item.get("revision")
            or anchor.get("head") != snapshot.get("head")
            or anchor.get("reason") != act.get("reason")
            or anchor.get("next_trigger") != act.get("next_trigger")
            or anchor.get("inner_path")
            != str(path.parent / f"{path.stem}.actions" / f"{_digest(target)}.json")
            or anchor.get("receipt_sha256") != _digest(receipt)
            or not isinstance(item.get("identity"), str)
            or not item["identity"]
            or not any(
                isinstance(record, Mapping)
                and record.get("source_run_id")
                == anchor.get("previous_run_id", recovery["previous_run_id"])
                and isinstance(record.get("targets"), Mapping)
                and isinstance(record["targets"].get(target), Mapping)
                and record["targets"][target].get("recovery") == "validated_inner_wait"
                and record["targets"][target].get("act_result") == act
                and record["targets"][target].get("revision") == item.get("revision")
                and record["targets"][target].get("identity") == item.get("identity")
                and record["targets"][target].get("item_sha256")
                == anchor.get("previous_item_sha256")
                for record in history
            )
        ):
            return False
        return _retained_blocked_act_wait_proof(path, target, item)
    resource = act.get("resource_evidence")
    proof = resource.get("inner_wait") if isinstance(resource, Mapping) else None
    receipt = act.get("queue_receipt")
    if (
        act.get("status") != "deferred"
        or act.get("reason") != "validated_inner_wait"
        or not isinstance(proof, Mapping)
        or not isinstance(receipt, Mapping)
        or proof.get("receipt_sha256") != _digest(receipt)
        or act.get("next_trigger") != proof.get("next_trigger")
        or anchor.get("revision") != item.get("revision")
        or anchor.get("head") != proof.get("head")
        or anchor.get("reason") != act.get("reason")
        or anchor.get("next_trigger") != act.get("next_trigger")
        or anchor.get("inner_path") != proof.get("inner_path")
        or anchor.get("receipt_sha256") != proof.get("receipt_sha256")
        or prepared.get("revision") != item.get("revision")
        or proof.get("revision") != item.get("revision")
        or not isinstance(item.get("identity"), str)
        or not item["identity"]
        or not any(
            isinstance(record, Mapping)
            and record.get("source_run_id")
            == anchor.get("previous_run_id", recovery["previous_run_id"])
            and isinstance(record.get("targets"), Mapping)
            and isinstance(record["targets"].get(target), Mapping)
            and record["targets"][target].get("recovery") == "validated_inner_wait"
            and record["targets"][target].get("act_result") == act
            and record["targets"][target].get("revision") == item.get("revision")
            and record["targets"][target].get("identity") == item.get("identity")
            and record["targets"][target].get("item_sha256") == anchor.get("previous_item_sha256")
            for record in history
        )
    ):
        return False
    return _valid_inner_wait(
        path,
        target,
        item.get("revision"),
        prepared.get("snapshot"),
        proof.get("reason"),
        proof.get("next_trigger"),
        proof,
        frontier_id=proof.get("frontier_id"),
        now=lambda: historical_now,
    )


def _safe_prior_continuation(
    prior_stop: Mapping[str, Any], previous: Mapping[str, Any], path: Path
) -> tuple[bool, bool, set[str]]:
    """Carry only exact native, read-only, or durable pre-fix wait failures."""
    reasons = prior_stop.get("reasons")
    rows = previous.get("targets")
    if prior_stop.get("valid") is not False or not isinstance(reasons, list) or not reasons:
        return False, False, set()
    if not isinstance(rows, Mapping):
        return False, False, set()

    native_targets: set[str] = set()
    recovered_wait_targets: set[str] = set()
    matched_reasons: set[str] = set()
    has_pending_blocker = False
    for reason in reasons:
        if reason == "pending_work_is_not_the_only_blocker":
            has_pending_blocker = True
            matched_reasons.add(reason)
            continue
        if not isinstance(reason, str):
            return False, False, set()
        if reason.startswith("unresolved_native_provider_outcome:"):
            matched = False
            for target, item in rows.items():
                if not isinstance(target, str) or not isinstance(item, Mapping):
                    continue
                if item.get("status") != "uncertain" or item.get("stage") not in {
                    "interpret",
                    "exception",
                }:
                    continue
                interpretation = {
                    "status": "uncertain",
                    "provider_outcome": item.get("provider_outcome_uncertain"),
                }
                if not _valid_uncertain_provider_outcome(interpretation, target, item):
                    continue
                run_id = item["provider_outcome_uncertain"]["actual"]["run_id"]
                expected = f"unresolved_native_provider_outcome:{target}:{run_id}"
                if reason == expected:
                    native_targets.add(target)
                    matched_reasons.add(reason)
                    matched = True
                    break
            if not matched:
                return False, False, set()
            continue
        if reason.startswith("unresolved_pipeline_work:"):
            matched = False
            for target, item in rows.items():
                if not isinstance(target, str) or not isinstance(item, Mapping):
                    continue
                status = item.get("status")
                if reason != f"unresolved_pipeline_work:{target}:{status}":
                    continue
                stage = item.get("stage")
                if (
                    status == "failed"
                    and stage in {"prepare", "interpret", "exception"}
                    and item.get("error") != UNBOUND_UNCERTAIN_PROVIDER_ERROR
                ):
                    matched = True
                elif (
                    status == "parked"
                    and stage == "act"
                    and item.get("known_completed_action") is True
                    and isinstance(item.get("progress_key"), str)
                    and bool(item.get("progress_key"))
                ):
                    matched = True
                elif (
                    status == "failed"
                    and stage == "act"
                    and _legacy_failed_act_wait_proof(path, target, item)
                ):
                    recovered_wait_targets.add(target)
                    matched = True
                if matched:
                    matched_reasons.add(reason)
                    break
            if not matched:
                return False, False, set()
            continue
        return False, False, set()

    if matched_reasons != set(reasons):
        return False, False, set()
    if has_pending_blocker and not any(
        isinstance(item, Mapping) and item.get("status") == "pending" for item in rows.values()
    ):
        return False, False, set()

    # Verify every nonterminal target is explained by one of the exact safe
    # categories above. This prevents a good reason from masking unknown work.
    for target, item in rows.items():
        if not isinstance(target, str) or not isinstance(item, Mapping):
            return False, False, set()
        status = item.get("status")
        if status in {"completed", "deferred", "pending"}:
            continue
        if (
            target in native_targets
            and status == "uncertain"
            and item.get("stage") in {"interpret", "exception"}
        ):
            continue
        if (
            status == "failed"
            and item.get("stage") in {"prepare", "interpret", "exception"}
            and item.get("error") != UNBOUND_UNCERTAIN_PROVIDER_ERROR
        ):
            continue
        if target in recovered_wait_targets and status == "failed" and item.get("stage") == "act":
            continue
        if (
            status == "parked"
            and item.get("stage") == "act"
            and item.get("known_completed_action") is True
            and isinstance(item.get("progress_key"), str)
            and bool(item.get("progress_key"))
        ):
            continue
        return False, False, set()
    return True, bool(native_targets), recovered_wait_targets


def _restored_compact_wait(
    target: str, item: Mapping[str, Any], history: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Restore only a derived wait view bound to immutable and current native proof."""
    if not (
        item.get("carried") is True
        and item.get("recovery_excluded") is True
        and item.get("status") == "deferred"
        and item.get("stage") == "act"
        and item.get("deferred_reason") == "validated_inner_wait"
        and item.get("results") == {}
    ):
        return None
    resource = item.get("resource_evidence")
    proof = resource.get("inner_wait") if isinstance(resource, Mapping) else None
    if not isinstance(proof, Mapping):
        return None
    candidates = [
        entry["targets"][target]
        for entry in history
        if isinstance(entry, Mapping)
        and isinstance(entry.get("targets"), Mapping)
        and isinstance(entry["targets"].get(target), Mapping)
        and entry["targets"][target].get("recovery") == "validated_inner_wait"
        and all(
            entry["targets"][target].get(key) == item.get(key)
            for key in ("status", "stage", "revision", "identity", "work_key", "resource_evidence")
        )
        and entry["targets"][target].get("next_trigger") == item.get("deferred_next_trigger")
    ]
    if not candidates:
        return None
    act = candidates[0].get("act_result")
    if (
        not isinstance(act, Mapping)
        or any(row.get("act_result") != act for row in candidates)
        or act.get("status") != "deferred"
        or act.get("reason") != "validated_inner_wait"
        or act.get("resource_evidence") != resource
        or act.get("next_trigger") != item.get("deferred_next_trigger")
        or not isinstance(act.get("queue_receipt"), Mapping)
        or _digest(act["queue_receipt"]) != proof.get("receipt_sha256")
        or any(row.get("act_receipt_sha256") != proof.get("receipt_sha256") for row in candidates)
    ):
        return None
    # This projection is wait proof only, never interpretation or completion evidence.
    snapshot = {
        "target": target,
        "revision": item.get("revision"),
        "head": proof.get("head"),
        "kind": "issue" if proof.get("head") is None else "pr",
        "wait_proof_only": True,
    }
    restored = dict(item)
    restored["results"] = {"prepare": {"snapshot": snapshot}, "act": dict(act)}
    return restored


def _restored_compact_refusal(
    path: Path, target: str, item: Mapping[str, Any], history: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Derive scheduling proof from an audited refusal, never model evidence."""
    barrier = item.get("recovery_barrier")
    if not (
        item.get("status") == "failed"
        and item.get("stage") == "act"
        and item.get("error") == "act returned unsupported or missing status"
        and item.get("results") == {}
        and not item.get("provider_outcome_uncertain")
        and item.get("known_completed_action") is not True
