                or operation.get("status") not in PENDING_OPERATION_STATES
            ):
                continue
            if not budget_available_at_start or not budget_available():
                pending_item["deferred_reason"] = "receipt_reserve"
                pending_item["deferred_next_trigger"] = "reconcile_next_round"
                continue
            if reconcile is None:
                resolution: Mapping[str, Any] = {
                    "status": "unknown",
                    "next_trigger": "reconcile_operation",
                }
            else:
                try:
                    bounded = dict(operation)
                    if frontier is not None:
                        # A fresh reconciliation read has its own request window;
                        # preserve the original effect deadline separately.
                        bounded["effect_deadline"] = operation.get("deadline")
                        assert finite_timeout is not None
                        bounded["deadline"] = float(now()) + finite_timeout
                        bounded["timeout_seconds"] = finite_timeout
                    else:
                        bounded["deadline"] = cutoff
                        assert legacy_deadline is not None
                        bounded["timeout_seconds"] = max(
                            0.0, _remaining(legacy_deadline, receipt_reserve_seconds, now)
                        )
                    resolution = reconcile(pending_target, bounded)
                except Exception as exc:
                    resolution = {"status": "unknown", "error_type": type(exc).__name__}
            if not isinstance(resolution, Mapping):
                resolution = {"status": "unknown"}
            resolution_status = resolution.get("status")
            if resolution_status == "completed":
                operation["status"] = "completed"
                operation["result"] = _json_copy(resolution.get("result", {}))
                operation["completed_at"] = float(now())
                pending_item["status"] = "observed"
                pending_item.pop("deferred_reason", None)
                pending_item.pop("deferred_next_trigger", None)
                _event(
                    round_state,
                    pending_target,
                    "reconciled_completed",
                    operation_id=operation.get("id"),
                )
            elif resolution_status == "confirmed_not_started":
                operation["status"] = "confirmed_not_started"
                operation["reconcile_next_trigger"] = resolution.get(
                    "next_trigger", "retry_same_operation"
                )
            elif resolution_status == "running":
                operation["status"] = "running"
                pending_item["status"] = "deferred"
                pending_item["deferred_reason"] = "operation_running"
                pending_item["deferred_next_trigger"] = resolution.get(
                    "next_trigger", "reconcile_operation"
                )
            elif resolution_status == "failed":
                operation["status"] = "failed"
                operation["result"] = _json_copy(resolution.get("result", {}))
                operation["next_trigger"] = resolution.get(
                    "next_trigger", "inspect_operation_failure"
                )
                pending_item["status"] = "deferred"
                pending_item["deferred_reason"] = "operation_failed"
                pending_item["deferred_next_trigger"] = operation["next_trigger"]
            else:
                operation["status"] = "uncertain"
                operation["next_trigger"] = resolution.get("next_trigger", "reconcile_operation")
                pending_item["status"] = "deferred"
                pending_item["deferred_reason"] = "operation_uncertain"
                pending_item["deferred_next_trigger"] = operation["next_trigger"]
            persist_state()

        # Observe every assigned target before queueing. Unexpected/invalid reads
        # become explicit blockers, never apparent idle targets.
        snapshots: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        source_revisions: dict[str, Any] = round_state.setdefault("source_revisions", {})
        # Identity mismatches are terminal for this immutable frontier and
        # must be excluded from later progression in the same round.
        stalled: set[str] = set()
        for target in targets:
            item = items.setdefault(target, {"operation": None, "operation_history": []})
            if not budget_available_at_start or not budget_available():
                if "revision" in item or "evidence" in item:
                    snapshot = _cached_snapshot(target, item)
                    item.update(snapshot)
                    item["owner"] = round_owner
                    item["observation_freshness"] = "cached_budget_exhausted"
                    source_revisions[target] = item.get("revision")
                else:
                    snapshot = {
                        "target": target,
                        "revision": None,
                        "action": "wait",
                        "eligible": True,
                        "requires_coordinator": False,
                        "reason": "unobserved_budget_exhausted",
                        "next_trigger": "retry_observation_next_round",
                        "evidence": {},
                        "operation_binding": {},
                        "claim_targets": [target],
                        "repo_keys": [_repo_key(target)],
                    }
                    item.update(snapshot)
                    item["owner"] = round_owner
                    item["observation_freshness"] = "unobserved_budget_exhausted"
                    source_revisions[target] = None
                snapshots[target] = snapshot
                _defer(item, "receipt_reserve", "retry_observation_next_round")
                persist_state()
                continue
            try:
                snapshot = _observe_or_error(observe, target)
            except Exception as exc:
                snapshot = _failure_observation(target, exc)
                round_state.setdefault("invalid_observations", {})[target] = type(exc).__name__
            changed = _set_observation(
                item, snapshot, owner=round_owner, source_revisions=source_revisions
            )
            snapshots[target] = snapshot
            if frontier is not None:
                from closer_frontier_policy import action_identity

                expected = frontier["bindings"][target]
                actual = None
                if isinstance(snapshot.get("revision"), str):
                    actual = action_identity(
                        target,
                        snapshot["revision"],
                        snapshot["action"],
                        snapshot["operation_binding"],
                    )
                if target not in round_state.get("invalid_observations", {}) and (
                    snapshot.get("revision") != expected["revision"]
                    or actual != expected["action_id"]
                ):
                    _defer(item, "finite_frontier_identity_mismatch", "new_frontier_required")
                    item["frontier_identity_mismatch"] = {
                        "expected": dict(expected),
                        "observed_revision": snapshot.get("revision"),
                        "observed_action_id": actual,
                    }
                    stalled.add(target)
                    persist_state()
                    continue
            if changed:
                _event(round_state, target, "revision_refreshed", revision=snapshot["revision"])
            item["status"] = "observed"
            item.pop("deferred_reason", None)
            item.pop("deferred_next_trigger", None)
            persist_state()
        round_state["source_hash"] = _digest(
            {target: source_revisions.get(target) for target in targets}
        )

        progress_targets: list[str] = []
        active_ops, active_mutating_repos = _active_operations(items)
        # Reconcile-completed assigned operations and confirmed-not-started items
        # using the current observation; stale snapshots are never executed.
        for target in targets:
            item = items[target]
            operation = item.get("operation")
            if not isinstance(operation, dict):
                continue
            if operation.get("status") == "completed":
                pass
            elif operation.get("status") in {"running", "uncertain", "submitted"}:
                _defer(
                    item,
                    (
                        "operation_running"
                        if operation.get("status") == "running"
                        else "operation_uncertain"
                    ),
                    operation.get("next_trigger", "reconcile_operation"),
                )
                stalled.add(target)
            elif operation.get("status") == "resource_wait":
                proof = verifier_resource_wait_proof(operation, target)
                if proof is None:
                    operation["status"] = "uncertain"
                    _defer(item, "operation_uncertain", "reconcile_invalid_resource_wait")
                else:
                    _defer(item, "verifier_resource_wait", verifier_resource_wait_event(proof))
                stalled.add(target)
            elif operation.get("status") == "failed":
                _defer(
                    item,
                    "operation_failed",
                    operation.get("next_trigger", "inspect_operation_failure"),
                )
                stalled.add(target)
            elif operation.get("status") == "confirmed_not_started":
                if operation.get("attempts", 0) > max_operation_retries:
                    operation["status"] = "uncertain"
                    _defer(item, "operation_uncertain", "manual_operation_reconciliation")
                    stalled.add(target)
                elif (
                    operation.get("revision") != snapshots[target].get("revision")
                    or operation.get("action") != snapshots[target].get("action")
                    or operation.get("binding") != snapshots[target].get("operation_binding")
                ):
                    operation["status"] = "abandoned"
                    operation["next_trigger"] = "reobserve_changed_revision"
                    item["operation_history"] = (item.get("operation_history", []) + [operation])[
                        -MAX_OPERATION_HISTORY:
                    ]
                    item["operation"] = None
                    _event(round_state, target, "abandoned_stale_intent")
            else:
                item["operation"] = None
        active_ops, active_mutating_repos = _active_operations(items)
        stop_launch_reason: str | None = None
        executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers, thread_name_prefix="closer-action")
        pending_claims: dict[int, list[str]] = {}

        def release_acquired(acquired: list[str]) -> list[str]:
            # An ordinary release attempt already reports its own failures. Do
            # not silently retry that cleanup when unwinding a later exception.
            pending_claims.pop(id(acquired), None)
            return _release_all(acquired, round_owner, release_call)

        try:
            slice_start_pass = int(round_state.get("passes", 0))
            # A finite frontier's only queue-pass bound is its immutable cardinality:
            # each selected target can start at most one source-bound operation.
            # Legacy rounds retain their configured pass limit unchanged.
            slice_pass_limit = (
                len(targets) if frontier is not None else slice_start_pass + max_passes
            )
            for pass_number in range(slice_start_pass, slice_pass_limit):
                if not budget_available_at_start or not budget_available():
                    stop_launch_reason = "receipt_reserve"
                    break
                round_state["passes"] = pass_number + 1
                round_state["last_event_at"] = float(now())
                made_progress = False
                launched: list[
                    tuple[str, dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], Future[Any], list[str], float]
                ] = []
                # Rotate start order each pass so repeated rounds don't privilege the
                # same first assignment.
                ordered = (
                    targets[pass_number % len(targets) :] + targets[: pass_number % len(targets)]
                    if targets
                    else []
                )
                for target in ordered:
                    if target in stalled:
                        continue
                    item = items[target]
                    snapshot = snapshots[target]
                    operation = item.get("operation")
                    if (
                        isinstance(operation, dict)
                        and operation.get("status") in PENDING_OPERATION_STATES
                    ):
                        _defer(
                            item,
                            (
                                "operation_running"
                                if operation.get("status") == "running"
                                else "operation_uncertain"
                            ),
                            operation.get("next_trigger", "reconcile_operation"),
                        )
                        stalled.add(target)
                        continue
                    if snapshot["action"] == "complete":
                        item["status"] = "complete"
                        item.pop("deferred_reason", None)
                        item.pop("deferred_next_trigger", None)
                        stalled.add(target)
                        continue
                    if not frontier_identity_matches(target, snapshot):
                        _defer(item, "finite_frontier_identity_mismatch", "new_frontier_required")
                        item["frontier_identity_mismatch"] = {
                            "expected": (
                                dict(frontier["bindings"][target]) if frontier is not None else {}
                            ),
                            "observed_revision": snapshot.get("revision"),
                            "observed_action": snapshot.get("action"),
                        }
                        stalled.add(target)
                        continue
                    if snapshot["action"] == "wait" or not snapshot["eligible"]:
                        why = snapshot["reason"] or "not_eligible"
                        trigger = snapshot["next_trigger"] or "wait_for_trigger"
                        _defer(item, why, trigger)
                        stalled.add(target)
                        continue
                    action = snapshot["action"]
                    if action not in ACTION_NAMES:
                        _defer(item, "invalid_action", "repair_observation")
                        stalled.add(target)
                        continue
                    if frontier is not None:
                        assert finite_timeout is not None
                        available = finite_timeout
                    else:
                        assert legacy_deadline is not None
                        available = _remaining(legacy_deadline, receipt_reserve_seconds, now)
                    if available <= 0 or available < min_action_seconds:
                        _defer(item, "receipt_reserve", "continue_next_round")
                        stop_launch_reason = "receipt_reserve"
                        continue
                    active_ops, active_mutating_repos = _active_operations(items)
                    if len(active_ops) >= max_workers:
                        _defer(item, "worker_capacity", "reconcile_running_operations")
                        continue
                    is_mutating = action not in READ_ONLY_ACTIONS and action not in TERMINAL_ACTIONS
                    repos = set(snapshot["repo_keys"])
                    if is_mutating and repos.intersection(active_mutating_repos):
                        _defer(item, "repo_operation_running", "reconcile_repo_operation")
                        continue

                    # Read immediately before the action. A moving revision invalidates
                    # prior evidence and this pass defers rather than acting on stale data.
                    try:
                        fresh = _observe_or_error(observe, target)
                    except Exception as exc:
                        fresh = _failure_observation(target, exc)
                        round_state.setdefault("invalid_observations", {})[target] = type(
                            exc
                        ).__name__
                    if fresh["revision"] != snapshot["revision"]:
                        _set_observation(
                            item, fresh, owner=round_owner, source_revisions=source_revisions
                        )
                        snapshots[target] = fresh
                        _defer(item, "revision_changed", "reobserve_next_pass")
                        _event(round_state, target, "stale_snapshot_rejected", action=action)
                        stalled.add(target)
                        continue
                    snapshot = fresh
                    snapshots[target] = fresh
                    _set_observation(
                        item, fresh, owner=round_owner, source_revisions=source_revisions
                    )
                    if not frontier_identity_matches(target, fresh):
                        _defer(item, "finite_frontier_identity_mismatch", "new_frontier_required")
                        item["frontier_identity_mismatch"] = {
                            "expected": (
                                dict(frontier["bindings"][target]) if frontier is not None else {}
                            ),
                            "observed_revision": fresh.get("revision"),
                            "observed_action": fresh.get("action"),
                        }
                        stalled.add(target)
                        continue
                    # Eligibility and lifecycle action can change without a new head
                    # (e.g. a human hold or a check conclusion). Never execute the old
                    # action with refreshed but contradictory selection evidence.
                    if fresh["action"] != action or not fresh["eligible"]:
                        _defer(item, "selection_changed", "reselect_current_lifecycle_action")
                        made_progress = True
                        continue
                    if fresh.get("revision") is None:
                        _defer(item, "revision_unavailable", "restore_source_observation")
                        stalled.add(target)
                        continue

                    acquired: list[str] = []
                    if is_mutating:
                        active_ops, active_mutating_repos = _active_operations(items)
                        repos = set(fresh["repo_keys"])
                        if repos.intersection(active_mutating_repos):
                            _defer(item, "repo_operation_running", "reconcile_repo_operation")
                            continue
                        # Statefile locks are private to a round. Shared repository
                        # claims serialize distinct targets across separate ledgers.
                        claim_targets = sorted(
                            {*(f"closer-repo:{repo}" for repo in repos), *fresh["claim_targets"]}
                        )
                        item["claim_targets"] = claim_targets
                        acquired, claim_error, claim_holder = _claim_all(
                            claim_targets, round_owner, claim_call, release_call, holder_call
                        )
                        if acquired:
                            pending_claims[id(acquired)] = acquired
                        if claim_error:
                            item["holder"] = (
                                _json_copy(claim_holder)
                                if isinstance(
                                    claim_holder, (dict, list, str, int, float, bool, type(None))
                                )
                                else {"status": "unreadable"}
                            )
                            _defer(item, "claim_held", "retry_after_claim_release")
                            _event(round_state, target, "claim_refused", holder=item["holder"])
                            stalled.add(target)
                            continue

                    if not budget_available():
                        release_acquired(acquired)
                        _defer(item, "receipt_reserve", "continue_next_round")
                        stop_launch_reason = "receipt_reserve"
                        continue
                    previous = item.get("operation")
                    # Keep a durable completed result available to the coordinator;
                    # restarting a round must not repeat the same action at the same
                    # source revision merely because process-local worker memory reset.
                    if (
                        isinstance(previous, dict)
                        and previous.get("status") == "completed"
                        and previous.get("action") == action
                        and previous.get("revision") == fresh["revision"]
                        and previous.get("binding") == fresh["operation_binding"]
                    ):
                        _defer(
                            item,
                            "completed_result_pending_integration",
                            "integrate_saved_operation_result",
                        )
                        item["saved_operation_result"] = _json_copy(previous.get("result", {}))
                        stalled.add(target)
                        release_acquired(acquired)
                        continue
                    if (
                        isinstance(previous, dict)
                        and previous.get("status") == "confirmed_not_started"
                    ):
                        op = previous
                        if op.get("attempts", 0) > max_operation_retries:
                            release_acquired(acquired)
                            _defer(item, "operation_uncertain", "manual_operation_reconciliation")
                            stalled.add(target)
                            continue
                        op["status"] = "submitted"
                        op["attempts"] = int(op.get("attempts", 0)) + 1
                        op["submitted_at"] = float(now())
                    else:
                        history = item.get("operation_history", [])
                        if isinstance(previous, dict):
                            history = (history + [previous])[-MAX_OPERATION_HISTORY:]
                        item["operation_history"] = history
                        op = {
                            "id": _operation_id(round_owner, target, action, fresh["revision"]),
                            "action": action,
                            "status": "submitted",
                            "attempts": 1,
                            "revision": fresh["revision"],
                            "owner": round_owner,
                            "repo_keys": fresh["repo_keys"],
                            "claim_targets": (
                                claim_targets if is_mutating else fresh["claim_targets"]
                            ),
                            "binding": _json_copy(fresh["operation_binding"], limit=8192),
                            "submitted_at": float(now()),
                        }
                    execution_context = None
                    if frontier is not None:
                        import closer_resources

                        try:
                            execution_context = closer_resources.capture_finite_execution_context(
                                target, frontier
                            )
                        except closer_resources.ResourceBlocked:
                            release_acquired(acquired)
                            _defer(
                                item, "finite_execution_context_refused", "inspect_original_owner"
                            )
                            stalled.add(target)
                            continue
                    op_deadline = request_deadline()
                    op["request_started_at"] = float(now())
                    op["deadline"] = op_deadline
                    op["timeout_seconds"] = max(0.0, op_deadline - float(now()))
                    if frontier is not None:
                        op["finite_frontier"] = frontier
                    item["operation"] = op
                    item["status"] = "submitted"
                    item.pop("deferred_reason", None)
                    item.pop("deferred_next_trigger", None)
                    persist_state()  # intent is durable before the callback
                    _event(
                        round_state,
                        target,
                        "operation_submitted",
                        operation_id=op["id"],
                        action=action,
                    )
                    persist_state()
                    started = monotonic()
                    callback_snapshot = _execution_snapshot(fresh)
                    invocation = (
                        execute,
                        target,
                        action,
                        callback_snapshot,
                        dict(op),
                        now,
                        execution_context,
                        path,
                    )
                    if publication_inline is not None:
                        publication_inline.check()
                    if inline or publication_inline is not None:
                        future = _inline_before_cutoff(*invocation)
                    else:
                        future = executor.submit(_invoke_before_cutoff, *invocation)

                    launched.append((target, item, op, future, acquired, started))

                # Wait for every action launched this pass before deciding whether to
                # launch another pass. The pool bounds concurrency and no background
                # callback survives round finalization.
                for target, item, op, future, acquired, started in launched:
                    action = op["action"]
                    result_persist_failed = False
                    try:
                        result, invoked_at = future.result()
                        if invoked_at is None:
                            op["status"] = "confirmed_not_started"
                            # Only the real queued cutoff path reaches here without
                            # entering execute. Never infer this from adapter JSON.
                            if action in {"initiate_verify", "post_merge_verify"}:
                                candidate = {
                                    "schema": "closer-verification-callback-not-invoked/v1",
                                    "target": target,
                                    "operation_id": op["id"],
                                    "action": action,
                                    "revision": op["revision"],
                                    "binding_sha256": _digest(op["binding"]),
                                    "deadline": op["deadline"],
                                    "observed_at": float(now()),
                                    "callback_invoked": False,
                                }
                                op["result"] = {"verification_callback_not_invoked": candidate}
                                if verification_callback_not_invoked_proof(op, target) is None:
                                    op.pop("result")
                            op["next_trigger"] = "continue_next_round"
                            _defer(item, "receipt_reserve", op["next_trigger"])
                            stop_launch_reason = "receipt_reserve"
                            stalled.add(target)
                            continue
                        op["invoked_at"] = invoked_at
                        if not isinstance(result, Mapping):
                            raise ValueError("execute must return an object")
                        result = dict(result)
                        result_status = result.get("status")
                        if result_status not in {
                            "completed",
                            "running",
                            "failed",
                            "uncertain",
                            "blocked",
                            "deferred",
                            "stale",
                            "not_started",
                            "resource_wait",
                        }:
                            raise ValueError("execute returned an unsupported operation status")
                        stored_result = {
                            key: value
                            for key, value in result.items()
                            if key not in {"status", "advanced", "next_trigger"}
                        }
                        op["result"] = _json_copy(stored_result)
                        op["elapsed_seconds"] = max(0.0, monotonic() - started)
                        op["status"] = result_status
                        op["next_trigger"] = result.get("next_trigger")
                        item["operation"] = op
                        if result_status == "resource_wait":
                            op["completed_at"] = float(now())
                            proof = verifier_resource_wait_proof(op, target)
                            if not _native_verify_wait_executor(execute) or proof is None:
                                raise ValueError("untrusted_native_verifier_prewrite_wait")
                            op["next_trigger"] = verifier_resource_wait_event(proof)
                            _defer(item, "verifier_resource_wait", op["next_trigger"])
                            stalled.add(target)
                        elif result_status == "completed":
                            op["completed_at"] = float(now())
                            # Post-effect observation may consult this same durable
                            # operation (for example an acknowledged verifier POST).
                            # Publish its confirmed result before that read; external
                            # snapshots need not change when a request is accepted.
                            try:
                                persist_state()
                            except Exception:
                                result_persist_failed = True
                                raise
                            if not budget_available_at_start or not budget_available():
                                item["observation_freshness"] = "cached_budget_exhausted"
                                if result.get("advisory_only") or result.get(
                                    "requires_coordinator"
                                ):
                                    item["requires_coordinator"] = True
                                    item["saved_operation_result"] = _json_copy(stored_result)
                                _defer(item, "receipt_reserve", "retry_observation_next_round")
                                stalled.add(target)
                                continue
                            after = _observe_or_error(observe, target)
                            changed = _set_observation(
                                item, after, owner=round_owner, source_revisions=source_revisions
                            )
                            snapshots[target] = after
                            advanced = (
                                bool(result.get("advanced")) or changed or after["action"] != action
                            )
                            if advanced:
                                made_progress = True
                                progress_targets.append(target)
                                round_state.setdefault("progress", []).append(
                                    {"target": target, "action": action, "at": float(now())}
                                )
                                item["status"] = "observed"
                                item.pop("deferred_reason", None)
                                item.pop("deferred_next_trigger", None)
                                _event(
                                    round_state,
                                    target,
                                    "action_advanced",
                                    action=action,
                                    revision=after["revision"],
                                )
                            else:
                                _defer(
                                    item,
                                    "no_progress",
                                    result.get("next_trigger") or "inspect_action_result",
                                )
                                stalled.add(target)
                        elif result_status == "running":
                            _defer(
                                item,
                                "operation_running",
                                result.get("next_trigger") or "reconcile_operation",
                            )
                            stalled.add(target)
                        elif result_status == "uncertain":
                            _defer(
                                item,
                                "operation_uncertain",
                                result.get("next_trigger") or "reconcile_operation",
                            )
                            stalled.add(target)
                        elif result_status == "not_started":
                            # The adapter must return this only before entering a remote
                            # mutation. Keep the durable intent for a later same-binding
                            # retry without misclassifying a failed read as an unknown write.
                            op["status"] = "confirmed_not_started"
                            op["next_trigger"] = (
                                result.get("next_trigger") or "refresh_remote_before_action"
                            )
                            _defer(item, "remote_action_not_started", op["next_trigger"])
                            stalled.add(target)
                        elif result_status == "blocked" and "merge_guard_refusal" in stored_result:
                            op.update(status="failed", outcome="blocked", completed_at=float(now()))
                            if (
                                not _native_verify_wait_executor(execute)
                                or merge_guard_refusal_proof(op, target) is None
                            ):
                                raise ValueError("untrusted_native_merge_guard_refusal")
                            op["next_trigger"] = "refresh_merge_guard_before_action"
                            _defer(item, "merge_guard_refused", op["next_trigger"])
                            stalled.add(target)
                        else:
                            if result_status == "stale":
                                try:
                                    latest = _observe_or_error(observe, target)
                                    _set_observation(
                                        item,
                                        latest,
                                        owner=round_owner,
                                        source_revisions=source_revisions,
                                    )
                                    snapshots[target] = latest
                                except Exception as refresh_exc:
                                    round_state.setdefault("invalid_observations", {})[target] = (
                                        type(refresh_exc).__name__
                                    )
                            op["status"] = "failed"
                            op["outcome"] = result_status
                            _defer(
                                item,
                                "operation_failed",
                                result.get("next_trigger") or "inspect_operation_failure",
                            )
                            stalled.add(target)
                    except Exception as exc:
                        op["status"] = "uncertain"
                        op["next_trigger"] = "reconcile_operation_before_retry"
                        op["error_type"] = type(exc).__name__
                        _defer(item, "operation_uncertain", op["next_trigger"])
                        stalled.add(target)
                        diagnostic = _fixed_controller_refusal(exc)
                        _event(
                            round_state,
                            target,
                            "execute_uncertain",
                            error_type=type(exc).__name__,
                            **({"fixed_refusal": diagnostic} if diagnostic is not None else {}),
                            **(
                                {"read_only_deadline_diagnostic": read_diagnostic}
                                if (read_diagnostic := _queued_read_failure(exc, op)) is not None
                                else {}
                            ),
                            **(
                                {"read_timing_capture_error": capture_error}
                                if (capture_error := _queued_read_capture_error(exc, op))
                                is not None
                                else {}
                            ),
                        )
                        if result_persist_failed:
                            # Durable control-plane failures are fatal, not provider
                            # failures. The finally write retains the unknown intent
                            # for reconciliation without allowing a second effect.
                            raise
                    finally:
                        released = release_acquired(acquired)
                        if released:
                            item["claim_release_failures"] = released
                            item["status"] = "deferred"
                            item["deferred_reason"] = "claim_release_failed"
                            item["deferred_next_trigger"] = "inspect_claim_state"
                            stalled.add(target)
                        persist_state()

                # Check an active write/observe callback did not overrun the action
                # cutoff. No further task is launched when only receipt reserve remains.
                if not budget_available_at_start or not budget_available():
                    stop_launch_reason = "receipt_reserve"
                    break
                # A full worker batch may have made no progress while untouched
                # assignments were only deferred for temporary capacity. Fill those
                # free slots rather than ending the whole round on the first stall.
                runnable_deferred = any(
                    target not in stalled
                    and items[target].get("eligible")
                    and items[target].get("deferred_reason")
                    in {"worker_capacity", "repo_operation_running"}
                    for target in targets
                )
                if not made_progress and not runnable_deferred:
                    break

        finally:
            # Fatal writes and BaseException exits may skip unprocessed futures.
            # Cancel only callbacks not yet started; wait for every actual worker
            # before dropping any remaining repository/source claims. Their
            # durable submitted/uncertain intents remain reconciliation fences.
            executor.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=True)
            for acquired in list(pending_claims.values()):
                release_acquired(acquired)
        # Final fresh observations are the basis of assignment accounting. Pending
        # operation state still prevents any second action even if the source read
        # already reflects its external change.
        active_ops, active_mutating_repos = _active_operations(items)
        for target in targets:
            item = items[target]
            if frontier is not None and target in round_state.get("invalid_observations", {}):
                _defer(item, "observation_failed", "retry_observation_next_round")
                continue
            if (
                frontier is not None
                and item.get("deferred_reason") == "finite_frontier_identity_mismatch"
            ):
                continue
            if not budget_available_at_start or not budget_available():
                # No final read is worth crossing the cutoff. The durable item is
                # explicitly marked cached or unobserved when the round started
                # without budget; otherwise it retains the freshest in-round view.
                if (
                    item.get("observation_freshness") == "fresh"
                    and snapshots.get(target, {}).get("action") == "complete"
                ):
                    item["status"] = "complete"
                    item.pop("deferred_reason", None)
                    item.pop("deferred_next_trigger", None)
                elif item.get("eligible") or item.get("requires_coordinator"):
                    _defer(item, "receipt_reserve", "retry_observation_next_round")
                continue
            operation = item.get("operation")
            if isinstance(operation, dict) and operation.get("status") in PENDING_OPERATION_STATES:
                if (
                    frontier is None
                    and legacy_deadline is not None
                    and _remaining(legacy_deadline, receipt_reserve_seconds, now) <= 0
                ):
                    _defer(item, "receipt_reserve", "reconcile_next_round")
                    continue
                reason = (
                    "operation_running"
                    if operation.get("status") == "running"
                    else "operation_uncertain"
                )
                _defer(item, reason, operation.get("next_trigger") or "reconcile_operation")
                continue
            try:
                final = _observe_or_error(observe, target)
            except Exception as exc:
                final = _failure_observation(target, exc)
                round_state.setdefault("invalid_observations", {})[target] = type(exc).__name__
            _set_observation(item, final, owner=round_owner, source_revisions=source_revisions)
            snapshots[target] = final
            if frontier is not None and target in round_state.get("invalid_observations", {}):
                _defer(item, "observation_failed", "retry_observation_next_round")
            elif (
                final.get("requires_coordinator")
                and frontier is None
                and legacy_deadline is not None
                and _remaining(legacy_deadline, receipt_reserve_seconds, now) <= 0
            ):
                _defer(item, "receipt_reserve", "continue_next_round")
            elif final["action"] == "complete":
                item["status"] = "complete"
                item.pop("deferred_reason", None)
                item.pop("deferred_next_trigger", None)
            elif not final["eligible"]:
                reason = final["reason"] or "not_eligible"
                trigger = final["next_trigger"] or "wait_for_trigger"
                _defer(item, reason, trigger)
            elif item.get("deferred_reason") in RESOURCE_DEFERRALS:
                item["status"] = "deferred"
            elif stop_launch_reason == "receipt_reserve":
                _defer(item, "receipt_reserve", "continue_next_round")
            elif item.get("deferred_reason") in {
                "operation_failed",
                "operation_uncertain",
                "no_progress",
                "revision_changed",
                "claim_release_failed",
                "completed_result_pending_integration",
            }:
                item["status"] = "deferred"
            elif (
                int(round_state.get("passes", 0)) >= slice_pass_limit
                and item.get("action") not in TERMINAL_ACTIONS
            ):
                _defer(item, "pass_limit", "continue_next_round")
            else:
                _defer(item, "unresolved_eligible_work", "continue_next_round")

        round_state["source_revisions"] = source_revisions
        round_state["source_hash"] = _digest(
            {target: source_revisions.get(target) for target in targets}
        )
        round_state["status"] = "finished"
        finished_at = float(now())
        accounting = [_account_row(target, items[target]) for target in targets]
        accounted_targets = [row["target"] for row in accounting]
        eligible_remaining = [
            row["target"]
            for row in accounting
            if (row["eligible"] or row["requires_coordinator"]) and row["status"] != "complete"
        ]
        integration_required = [row["target"] for row in accounting if row["requires_coordinator"]]
        deferred = [row for row in accounting if row["status"] == "deferred"]
        receipt = {
            "schema": RECEIPT_SCHEMA,
            "started_at": round_state["started_at"],
            "finished_at": finished_at,
            **({"deadline": round_state["deadline"]} if frontier is None else {}),
            "receipt_reserve_seconds": round_state["receipt_reserve_seconds"],
            "owner": round_owner,
            "assignment_targets": targets,
            "assignment_hash": assignment_hash,
            "source_hash": round_state["source_hash"],
            "accounted_targets": accounted_targets,
            "accounting": accounting,
            "eligible_remaining": eligible_remaining,
            "integration_required": integration_required,
            "deferred": deferred,
            "progress": list(round_state.get("progress", [])),
            "events": list(round_state.get("events", [])),
            "continuation_required": bool(eligible_remaining),
        }
        validation_state = (
            {**state, "items": items, "round": round_state}
            if frontier_bucket is not None
            else state
        )
        validation = _validate_data(
            validation_state,
            receipt,
            assignment_targets=targets,
            now_value=finished_at,
            holder_fn=holder_call,
        )
        receipt.update(validation)
        round_state["receipt"] = receipt
        persist_state()
        return receipt

"""Resource-scoped state for the opt-in closer coordinator mode.

Legacy ``closer_pipeline.run_pipeline`` serialises a whole round behind one
``.runlock`` and rewrites one shared JSON document. The scoped mode shards that
state per target instead: one directory per target holding its own pipeline
state file and a lease, plus a versioned ``contract.json`` for the whole root.
Nothing here reads or writes the legacy ledger.

Lease rules (the only exclusion between co-coordinators of one target):

* The holder keeps a non-blocking ``flock`` for the life of its process, so a
  crashed owner releases implicitly and a live owner can never be evicted.
* ``lease.json`` carries a monotonic epoch. Every state commit of the shard
  re-checks, immediately before the atomic replace, that the lease is still
  held, still carries the holder's epoch, and has not passed its commit expiry.
  A stale or expired holder therefore fails closed instead of committing.
* The flock is held only for one target's work, never across targets, so a
  contested or unknown target blocks only itself.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import re
import stat
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import weakref
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping

CONTRACT_SCHEMA = "closer-scoped-state/v1"
LAYOUT = 1
COORDINATOR_MODES = ("legacy", "resource_scoped")
MODE_ENV = "ORCH_CLOSER_COORDINATOR_MODE"
# A holder may finish its final receipt commit this long after the round deadline.
LEASE_COMMIT_GRACE_SECONDS = 120.0
# Longest a short exclusive resource claim or a pool slot is awaited (also capped by the deadline).
RESOURCE_WAIT_SECONDS = 30.0
_POLL_SECONDS = 0.02
_TARGET_RE = re.compile(r"^([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)#([0-9]+)$")
# Kinds whose in-flight effect leaves a durable intent (an unknown survives a crash).
DURABLE_KINDS = frozenset({"pr", "issue", "branch", "worktree"})
RESOURCE_KINDS = DURABLE_KINDS | {"repo"}


class IncompatibleStateContract(RuntimeError):
    """The scoped root was written by a contract this code does not speak."""


class StaleLease(RuntimeError):
    """The holder lost, released or outlived its lease and may not commit."""


class CorruptShard(RuntimeError):
    """A lease or shard record exists but cannot be trusted; never reset to a fresh epoch."""


class ResourceBlocked(RuntimeError):
    """A mutation reservation or pool slot was not obtained; the effect was NOT started."""


class FinitePoolUncertain(RuntimeError):
    """A bounded finite request returned with an owned process group unverified."""

    def __init__(self, fence):
        super().__init__("finite request process cleanup is uncertain")
        self.finite_pool_fence = fence


class ScopeBlocked(ResourceBlocked):
    """A fresh scope proof refused the callback before any provider or effect started."""

    def __init__(self, reason, proof):
        super().__init__(reason)
        self.proof = proof


_NATIVE_INTERPRET_WRAPPERS: weakref.WeakKeyDictionary = weakref.WeakKeyDictionary()
_NATIVE_INTAKE_SCOPE_CALLBACKS: weakref.WeakKeyDictionary = weakref.WeakKeyDictionary()


def native_interpretation_callback(callback):
    """Resolve only wrappers created here; never trust callable attributes."""
    return _NATIVE_INTERPRET_WRAPPERS.get(callback, callback)


def resolve_mode(mode: str | None, environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> str:
    chosen = mode if mode is not None else (environ or os.environ).get(MODE_ENV, "legacy")
    chosen = chosen or "legacy"
    if chosen not in COORDINATOR_MODES:
        raise ValueError(f"coordinator mode must be one of {COORDINATOR_MODES}, got {chosen!r}")
    return chosen


def capability(pipeline_schema: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """What this code can speak, for a release installer deciding a version pin."""
    return {
        "contract_schema": CONTRACT_SCHEMA,
        "layout": LAYOUT,
        "pipeline_schema": pipeline_schema,
        "modes": list(COORDINATOR_MODES),
        "version_pin": True,
        "resource_keys_callback": True,
        "pool_lease_callback": True,
        "scoped_validate_stop": True,
        "proven_runtime_promotion": False,
        "coordination_gates": 1,
        "requires_terminal_uncooperative_writers": True,
    }


def scoped_root(state_path: str | Path) -> Path:
    path = Path(state_path)
    return path.with_name(path.name + ".scoped")


def shard_dir(root: Path, target: str) -> Path:
    return root / "targets" / hashlib.sha256(canonical_target(target).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]


def _atomic_write(path: Path, doc: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    fd, temp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp", dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            json.dump(doc, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
            stream.write("\n")
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temp, path)
        _fsync_dir(path.parent)
    finally:
        with contextlib.suppress(FileNotFoundError):
            os.unlink(temp)


def _fsync_dir(directory: Path) -> None:
    fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def canonical_target(target: str) -> str:
    """Strict identity: ``Owner/Repo#N`` folds to lower-case owner/repo; anything else is exact.

    Surrounding whitespace or control characters are refused, never trimmed, so two spellings
    cannot name two shards for one resource.
    """
    if not isinstance(target, str) or not target or target != target.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"non-canonical target identity {target!r}")
    if any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in target):
        raise ValueError(f"control character in target identity {target!r}")
    match = _TARGET_RE.match(target)
    if match:
        return f"{match.group(1).lower()}/{match.group(2).lower()}#{int(match.group(3))}"
    return target


def normalize_key(key: str) -> str:
    """``kind:value`` resource key; GitHub owner/repo is case-folded, branch names are not."""
    if not isinstance(key, str) or ":" not in key or key != key.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"resource key must be 'kind:value', got {key!r}")
    kind, value = key.split(":", 1)
    if kind not in RESOURCE_KINDS or not value:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown resource kind in {key!r}; known: {sorted(RESOURCE_KINDS)}")
    if kind in {"pr", "issue"}:
        match = _TARGET_RE.match(value)
        if not match:
            raise ValueError(f"{kind} key must be owner/repo#N, got {key!r}")
        return f"{kind}:{match.group(1).lower()}/{match.group(2).lower()}#{int(match.group(3))}"
    if kind == "repo":
        return f"repo:{value.lower()}"
    if kind == "branch":
        repo, sep, branch = value.partition("@")
        if not sep or "/" not in repo or not branch:
            raise ValueError(f"branch key must be branch:owner/repo@name, got {key!r}")
        return f"branch:{repo.lower()}@{branch}"
    return f"worktree:{value}"


def default_resource_keys(target: str) -> list[str]:
    """Conservative act-stage keys for a target the callback did not describe."""
    match = _TARGET_RE.match(canonical_target(target))
    if not match:
        return []
    owner, repo = match.group(1).lower(), match.group(2).lower()
    return [f"pr:{owner}/{repo}#{int(match.group(3))}", f"repo:{owner}/{repo}"]


_INVENTORY_REQUEST = threading.local()
_INVENTORY_OWNERS = threading.local()


@contextlib.contextmanager
def inventory_request(deadline, *, now=time.time):
    """Carry one finite request window through nested shard journal commits."""
    previous = getattr(_INVENTORY_REQUEST, "window", None)
    previous_limit = getattr(_INVENTORY_REQUEST, "monotonic_limit", None)
    sampled_at, monotonic_at = now(), time.monotonic()
    if any(
        isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value)
        for value in (deadline, sampled_at, monotonic_at)
    ):
        raise ResourceBlocked("finite request window requires finite numeric clocks and deadline")
    limit = monotonic_at + max(0.0, deadline - sampled_at)
    if not math.isfinite(limit):
        raise ResourceBlocked("finite request monotonic deadline is not finite")
    if previous is not None:
        deadline = min(deadline, previous[0])
    if previous_limit is not None:
        limit = min(limit, previous_limit)
    _INVENTORY_REQUEST.window = (deadline, now)
    _INVENTORY_REQUEST.monotonic_limit = limit
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        _INVENTORY_REQUEST.window = previous
        _INVENTORY_REQUEST.monotonic_limit = previous_limit


def finite_request_remaining() -> float | None:
    """Return this active request's remaining time without starting a new window."""
    window = getattr(_INVENTORY_REQUEST, "window", None)
    if window is None:
        return None
    deadline, now = window
    sampled_at, monotonic_at = now(), time.monotonic()
    limit = getattr(_INVENTORY_REQUEST, "monotonic_limit", None)
    if any(
        isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value)
        for value in (deadline, sampled_at, monotonic_at, limit)
    ):
        raise ResourceBlocked("finite request window has an invalid clock or deadline")
    if not isinstance(limit, (int, float)):
        raise ResourceBlocked("finite request window has no monotonic deadline")
    return max(0.0, min(deadline - sampled_at, limit - monotonic_at))


@contextlib.contextmanager
def inventory_lock(root, *, exclusive=False, deadline=None, now=time.time):
    """Bind short metadata/state commits to a census; never held across target work."""
    root = Path(root)
    lock = root.with_name(root.name + ".inventory.lock")
    if not exclusive and not lock.exists():
        # Pure inventory of an old/absent root creates nothing. New writers
        # publish this lock before exposing any new shard directory.
        yield
        return
    if exclusive:
        root.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with lock.open("a+" if exclusive else "r") as handle:
        window = getattr(_INVENTORY_REQUEST, "window", None)
        if deadline is None and window is not None:
            deadline, now = window
        mode = fcntl.LOCK_EX if exclusive else fcntl.LOCK_SH
        if deadline is None:
            fcntl.flock(handle, mode)
        else:
            if (
                not isinstance(deadline, (int, float))
                or isinstance(deadline, bool)
                or not math.isfinite(deadline)
            ):
                raise ResourceBlocked("inventory lock requires a finite request deadline")
            # Wall time is the original request's authority; monotonic time also
            # bounds the wait if the wall clock moves backwards while contended.
            monotonic_limit = time.monotonic() + max(0.0, deadline - now())
            while True:
                try:
                    fcntl.flock(handle, mode | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
                    break
                except BlockingIOError:
                    if now() >= deadline or time.monotonic() >= monotonic_limit:
                        raise ResourceBlocked("inventory lock exceeded finite request window")
                    time.sleep(min(_POLL_SECONDS, max(0.0, monotonic_limit - time.monotonic())))
        token = object()
        owners = getattr(_INVENTORY_OWNERS, "active", {})
        _INVENTORY_OWNERS.active = owners
        owners[token] = (root.resolve(), os.getpid())
        try:
            yield token
        finally:
            owners.pop(token, None)
            fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_UN)


@contextlib.contextmanager
def inventory_census(root, *, owner=None):
    """Read within an explicitly supplied live inventory owner, or acquire normally.

    A capability is valid only while its originating lock is held by this thread
    and process for this exact physical root. Ordinary locks stay non-reentrant.
    """
    if owner is None:
        with inventory_lock(root):
            yield
        return
    if getattr(_INVENTORY_OWNERS, "active", {}).get(owner) != (Path(root).resolve(), os.getpid()):
        raise ResourceBlocked("invalid caller-owned inventory census")
    yield


def open_root(state_path, *, pipeline_schema, pin=None, deadline=None, now=time.time):
    with inventory_lock(scoped_root(state_path), exclusive=True, deadline=deadline, now=now):
        return _open_root(state_path, pipeline_schema=pipeline_schema, pin=pin)


def _open_root(
    state_path: str | Path, *, pipeline_schema: str, pin: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
) -> Path:
    """Create the scoped root on first use, or refuse an incompatible one.

    ``pin`` is the contract a version-pinned worker was built for
    (``{"layout": 1, "pipeline_schema": ...}``). It is checked against what this code
    speaks BEFORE any directory is created, and against an existing root before it is
    used; a root that differs is refused, never migrated in place.
    """
    root = scoped_root(state_path)
    want = {
        "schema": CONTRACT_SCHEMA,
        "layout": LAYOUT,
        "pipeline_schema": pipeline_schema,
        "coordination_gates": 1,
    }
    if pin is not None and any(
        type(want.get(k)) is not type(v) or want.get(k) != v for k, v in pin.items()
    ):
        raise IncompatibleStateContract(f"worker pin {dict(pin)!r} does not match {want!r}")
    contract = root / "contract.json"
    if not contract.exists():
        (root / "targets").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        temp = root / f".contract.{os.getpid()}.{threading.get_ident()}.tmp"
        with temp.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True))
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        try:
            os.link(temp, contract)  # atomic create-if-absent: concurrent first users agree
        except FileExistsError:
            pass
        finally:
            with contextlib.suppress(FileNotFoundError):
                temp.unlink()

    try:
        found = json.loads(contract.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise IncompatibleStateContract(f"unreadable scoped contract: {exc}") from exc
    comparable = {k: found.get(k) for k in want} if isinstance(found, dict) else None
    if json.dumps(comparable, sort_keys=True) != json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True):
        raise IncompatibleStateContract(f"scoped root contract {found!r} != supported {want!r}")
    (root / "targets").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return root


class Lease:
    def __init__(
        self,
        directory: Path,
        target: str,
        owner: str,
        epoch: int,
        handle,
        expires_at,
        finite_frontier=None,
    ):
        self.directory = directory
        self.target = target
        self.owner = owner
        self.epoch = epoch
        self.finite_frontier = finite_frontier
        self.expires_at = float(expires_at) if finite_frontier is None else None
        self._handle = handle
        self.state_path = directory / "state.json"

    def check(self, now: Callable[[], float] = time.time) -> None:
        if self._handle is None or self._handle.closed:
            raise StaleLease(f"{self.target}: lease released")
        if self.finite_frontier is None:
            expires_at = self.expires_at
            if expires_at is None or now() > expires_at:
                raise StaleLease(f"{self.target}: lease expired at {expires_at}")
        try:
            doc = json.loads((self.directory / "lease.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise StaleLease(f"{self.target}: lease record unreadable: {exc}") from exc
        if doc.get("epoch") != self.epoch or doc.get("owner") != self.owner:
            raise StaleLease(f"{self.target}: lease superseded by {doc.get('owner')!r}")
        if self.finite_frontier is not None and (
            doc.get("finite_frontier") != self.finite_frontier
            or type(doc.get("epoch")) is not int
            or doc.get("target") != canonical_target(self.target)
            or doc.get("authority") != "held-owner-epoch-lock/v1"
            or "expires_at" in doc
        ):
            raise StaleLease(f"{self.target}: finite frontier lease identity changed")

    def release(self) -> None:
        if self.finite_frontier is not None:
            try:
                with inventory_lock(
                    self.directory.parents[1], exclusive=True, deadline=time.time()
                ):
                    self._release()
            except ResourceBlocked:
                # The callback has ended. Unlock without waiting; its durable
                # running row/intents retain UNKNOWN and cannot be replayed.
                self._release()
            return
        with inventory_lock(self.directory.parents[1], exclusive=True):
            self._release()

    def _release(self) -> None:
        handle, self._handle = self._handle, None
        if handle is not None and not handle.closed:
            with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
                fcntl.flock(handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)
            handle.close()


def acquire(
    root,
    target,
    *,
    owner,
    expires_at=None,
    now=time.time,
    finite_frontier=None,
    request_deadline=None,
):
    if finite_frontier is not None:
        from closer_frontier_policy import validate_frontier

        finite_frontier = validate_frontier(finite_frontier)
        if expires_at is not None or target not in finite_frontier["targets"]:
            raise ValueError("finite target lease requires its selected frontier and no duration")
        if request_deadline is None:
            request_deadline = now() + RESOURCE_WAIT_SECONDS
    elif expires_at is None:
        raise ValueError("legacy target lease requires its original expiry")
    with inventory_lock(root, exclusive=True, deadline=request_deadline, now=now):
        return _acquire(
            root,
            target,
            owner=owner,
            expires_at=expires_at,
            now=now,
            finite_frontier=finite_frontier,
        )


def _acquire(
    root: Path,
    target: str,
    *,
    owner: str,
    expires_at: float | None,
    now: Callable[[], float] = time.time,
    finite_frontier=None,
) -> Lease | None:
    """Take the target's lease without waiting; ``None`` means a live owner holds it."""
    directory = shard_dir(root, target)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    handle = (directory / "lease.lock").open("a+")
    try:
        fcntl.flock(handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    except BlockingIOError:
        handle.close()
        return None
    canonical = canonical_target(target)
    record = directory / "lease.json"
    try:
        if record.exists():
            previous = json.loads(record.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            prior = previous.get("epoch") if isinstance(previous, dict) else None
            if (
                isinstance(prior, bool)
                or not isinstance(prior, int)
                or prior < 1
                or previous.get("target") != canonical
            ):
                raise CorruptShard(f"{target}: malformed prior lease {previous!r}")
            epoch = prior + 1
        elif (directory / "state.json").exists():
            raise CorruptShard(f"{target}: shard state exists but its lease record is missing")
        else:
            epoch = 1  # genuinely first lease: no record and no state
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        handle.close()
        raise CorruptShard(f"{target}: unreadable prior lease: {exc}") from exc
    except CorruptShard:
        handle.close()
        raise
    try:
        _atomic_write(
            directory / "lease.json",
            {
                "target": canonical,
                "owner": owner,
                "epoch": epoch,
                "acquired_at": now(),
                **(
                    {"expires_at": expires_at}
                    if finite_frontier is None
                    else {
                        "finite_frontier": finite_frontier,
                        "authority": "held-owner-epoch-lock/v1",
                    }
                ),
            },
        )
    except BaseException:
        handle.close()
        raise
    return Lease(directory, target, owner, epoch, handle, expires_at, finite_frontier)


# state-file path -> commit fence; consulted by closer_pipeline._save before replace. Keys are
# per-shard paths and a shard is only ever fenced by its flock holder, so entries never collide;
# registration under a mutex refuses a duplicate instead of overwriting another thread's fence.
SAVE_FENCES: dict[str, Callable[[], None]] = {}
FENCE_IDENTITIES: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
_FENCE_GUARD = threading.Lock()


def fence_for(path: str | Path) -> Callable[[], None] | None:
    with _FENCE_GUARD:
        return SAVE_FENCES.get(str(path))


def fence_identity(path):
    with _FENCE_GUARD:
        identity = FENCE_IDENTITIES.get(str(path))
        return dict(identity) if identity is not None else None


@contextlib.contextmanager
def fenced(lease: Lease, now: Callable[[], float] = time.time):
    key = str(lease.state_path)
    with _FENCE_GUARD:
        if key in SAVE_FENCES:
            raise StaleLease(f"{lease.target}: shard already fenced by another holder")
        SAVE_FENCES[key] = lambda: lease.check(now)
        FENCE_IDENTITIES[key] = {
            "target": canonical_target(lease.target),
            "owner": lease.owner,
            "epoch": lease.epoch,
        }
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        with _FENCE_GUARD:
            SAVE_FENCES.pop(key, None)
            FENCE_IDENTITIES.pop(key, None)


_UNRESOLVED = {"running", "uncertain"}


def _unresolved_effect(path: Path, target: str, row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str | None:
    """Mode switches cannot turn an explicit unknown effect into fresh authority."""
    if row.get("status") in _UNRESOLVED:
        return f"{row['status']}_outcome"
    if row.get("status") == "queued" and row.get("stage") == "exception":
        return "unverified_exception_outcome"
    # A scheduler stage/status change cannot discharge an explicitly retained
    # quarantine or a provider's unknown outcome. Both mode directions use this
    # same per-target predicate before admitting any callback.
    barrier = row.get("recovery_barrier")
    if barrier is not None:
        if isinstance(barrier, Mapping):
            if barrier.get("schema") == "closer-unverified-read-barrier/v1":
                return "unverified_read_outcome"
            if barrier.get("schema") == "closer-unverified-act-barrier/v1":
                return "unverified_act_outcome"
        return "unverified_recovery_outcome"
    uncertainty = row.get("provider_outcome_uncertain")
    if uncertainty is not None and uncertainty is not False:
        return "provider_uncertain_outcome"
    if row.get("error") in {
        "expired read deferral lacks a verified terminal resource boundary",
        "expired read retained a historical wait from another revision",
        "interrupted read lacks a verified terminal boundary",
    }:
        return "unverified_read_outcome"
    if row.get("status") != "failed" or row.get("stage") != "act":
        return None
    results = row.get("results")
    act = results.get("act") if isinstance(results, Mapping) else None
    explicit_unknown = row.get("error") == "act returned unsupported or missing status" or (
        isinstance(act, Mapping)
        and (
            act.get("status") in {"unknown", "uncertain", "running", "submitted"}
            or act.get("outcome_uncertain") is True
        )
    )
    if not explicit_unknown:
        return None
    # An existing strict receipt can affirmatively prove a pre-fix no-operation
    # wait. A durable recovery barrier is never discharged by this read-only guard.
    import closer_pipeline as cp

    if cp._legacy_failed_act_wait_proof(path, target, row):
        return None
    return "unverified_act_outcome"


def finite_unresolved(doc):
    """A mode switch cannot replay any unfinished frozen frontier item."""
    from closer_frontier_policy import TERMINAL_STATES, validate_frontier

    entries = doc.get("frontiers", {})
    if not isinstance(entries, dict):
        raise ValueError("malformed finite frontier namespace")
    found = {}
    for frontier_id, entry in entries.items():
        descriptor = validate_frontier(entry.get("finite_frontier"))
        items = entry.get("items")
        if (
            entry.get("schema") != "closer-pipeline-frontier/v2"
            or descriptor["frontier_id"] != frontier_id
            or not isinstance(items, dict)
            or not items
            or not set(items).issubset(descriptor["targets"])
        ):
            raise ValueError("malformed finite frontier history")
        for target, row in items.items():
            if not isinstance(row, dict):
                raise ValueError("malformed finite frontier item")
            act = row.get("results", {}).get("act")
            if (
                row.get("status") not in TERMINAL_STATES
                or row.get("stage_status") == "unknown"
                or row.get("recovery_barrier") is not None
                or row.get("provider_outcome_uncertain") not in (None, False)
                or (
                    isinstance(act, Mapping)
                    and (
                        act.get("status") in {"unknown", "uncertain", "running", "submitted"}
                        or act.get("outcome_uncertain") is True
                    )
                )
            ):
                found[canonical_target(target)] = "finite_frontier_unresolved"
    return found


def legacy_unresolved(state_path: str | Path) -> tuple[dict[str, str], str | None]:
    """Targets the LEGACY ledger leaves unresolved, read-only.

    Returns ``({target: reason}, error)``. An unreadable ledger returns an error
    and the caller must fence everything: unknown is never clear.
    """
    path = Path(state_path)
    if not path.exists():
        return {}, None
    try:
        doc = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        runs = doc.get("runs", {})
        carry = doc.get("carry", {})
        found: dict[str, str] = {}
        for run in runs.values():
            for target, row in (run.get("targets") or {}).items():
                if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
                    raise ValueError(f"legacy row for {target!r} is not an object")
                reason = _unresolved_effect(path, target, row)
                if reason:
                    found[canonical_target(target)] = "legacy_" + reason
        for target, row in carry.items():
            if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
                raise ValueError(f"legacy carry row for {target!r} is not an object")
            reason = _unresolved_effect(path, target, row)
            if reason:
                found[canonical_target(target)] = "legacy_" + reason
        found.update(finite_unresolved(doc))
        return found, None
    except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError, TypeError) as exc:
        return {}, f"legacy ledger unreadable: {exc}"


def _fenced_row(reason: str, detail: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row: dict[str, Any] = {
        "status": "deferred",
        "stage": "prepare",
        "results": {},
        "deferred_reason": reason,
        "deferred_next_trigger": "next_round",
        "scoped_fence": True,
    }
    if detail:
        row["error"] = detail[:500]
    return row


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- rollback guard


def scoped_rollback_report(state_path: str | Path) -> tuple[dict[str, str], list[str]]:
    """``({target: reason}, malformed)`` read from the scoped shards, read-only.

    A shard names its target only inside its own records, so a shard that cannot be read
    (or holds a malformed row) cannot be mapped to a target: it is listed in ``malformed``
    and the caller must treat EVERY target as affected. Unknown is never clear.
    A shard whose lease is currently held by a live scoped coordinator is running.
    """
    found: dict[str, str] = {}
    malformed: list[str] = []
    root = scoped_root(state_path)
    if not root.exists():
        return found, malformed
    base = root / "targets"
    if not (root / "contract.json").exists() or not base.is_dir():
        return found, ["scoped root without contract or targets directory"]
    try:
        import closer_pipeline as cp

        contract = json.loads((root / "contract.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        expected = {
            "schema": CONTRACT_SCHEMA,
            "layout": LAYOUT,
            "pipeline_schema": cp.SCHEMA,
            "coordination_gates": 1,
        }
        if not isinstance(contract, dict) or any(
            type(contract.get(k)) is not type(v) or contract.get(k) != v
            for k, v in expected.items()
        ):
            return found, ["incompatible scoped coordination contract"]
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        return found, [f"unreadable scoped coordination contract: {exc}"]
    for shard in sorted(p for p in base.iterdir() if p.is_dir()):
        try:
            lease_doc = None
            if (shard / "lease.json").exists():
                lease_doc = json.loads((shard / "lease.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                if not isinstance(lease_doc, dict) or not isinstance(lease_doc.get("target"), str):
                    raise ValueError("lease record without a target")
            lock_path = shard / "lease.lock"
            if lock_path.exists():
                with lock_path.open("a+") as probe:
                    try:
                        fcntl.flock(probe.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
                        fcntl.flock(probe.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)
                    except BlockingIOError:
                        if lease_doc is None:
                            raise ValueError("lease held but its record is missing")
                        found[lease_doc["target"]] = "scoped_lease_held"
            state = shard / "state.json"
            if not state.exists():
                continue
            doc = json.loads(state.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            for run in doc["runs"].values():
                for target, row in run["targets"].items():
                    if not isinstance(row, dict):
                        raise ValueError(f"row for {target!r} is not an object")
                    reason = _unresolved_effect(state, target, row)
                    if reason:
                        found[canonical_target(target)] = "scoped_" + reason
            for target, row in doc.get("carry", {}).items():
                if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
                    raise ValueError(f"carry row for {target!r} is not an object")
                reason = _unresolved_effect(state, target, row)
                if reason:
                    found[canonical_target(target)] = "scoped_" + reason
            found.update(finite_unresolved(doc))
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError) as exc:
            malformed.append(f"{shard.name}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"[:200])
    return found, malformed


def scoped_unresolved(state_path: str | Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Targets whose shard still holds a running/uncertain row; malformed shards are keyed
    ``unreadable_shard:<dir>`` (the rollback guard uses ``scoped_rollback_report``)."""
    found, malformed = scoped_rollback_report(state_path)
    return {
        **{t: r.split("_", 1)[1].split("_outcome")[0] for t, r in found.items()},
